text_en: The word of the Lord , that came to Osee , the son of Beeri, in the days of Ozias , Joathan, Achaz , and Ezechias , kings of Juda , and in the days of Jeroboam , the son of Joas, king of Israel .
text_la: Verbum Domini, quod factum est ad Osee, filium Beeri, in diebus Oziæ, Joathan, Achaz, Ezechiæ, regum Juda; et in diebus Jeroboam, filii Joas, regis Israël.
text_pt: Palavra do SENHOR, que foi dirigida a Oséias, filho de Beeri, nos dias de Uzias, Jotão, Acaz, Ezequias, reis de Judá, e nos dias de Jeroboão, filho de Joás, rei de Israel.
text_el: λόγος κυρίου ὃς ἐγενήθη πρὸς Ωσηε τὸν τοῦ Βεηρι ἐν ἡμέραις Οζιου καὶ Ιωαθαμ καὶ Αχαζ καὶ Εζεκιου βασιλέων Ιουδα καὶ ἐν ἡμέραις Ιεροβοαμ υἱοῦ Ιωας βασιλέως Ισραηλ

text_en: The beginning of the Lord's speaking by Osee : and the Lord said to Osee : Go, take you a wife of fornications, and have of her children of fornications: for the land by fornication shall depart from the Lord .
text_la: Principium loquendi Domino in Osee. Et dixit Dominus ad Osee : Vade, sume tibi uxorem fornicationum, et fac tibi filios fornicationum, quia fornicans fornicabitur terra a Domino.
text_pt: O princípio da palavra do Senhor por meio de Oséias. Disse, pois, o Senhor a Oséias: Vai, toma uma mulher de prostituições, e filhos de prostituição; porque a terra certamente se prostitui, desviando-se do Senhor.
text_el: ἀρχὴ λόγου κυρίου πρὸς Ωσηε καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Ωσηε βάδιζε λαβὲ σεαυτῷ γυναῖκα πορνείας καὶ τέκνα πορνείας διότι ἐκπορνεύουσα ἐκπορνεύσει ἡ γῆ ἀπὸ ὄπισθεν τοῦ κυρίου

text_en: So he went and took Gomer, the daughter of Debelaim: and she conceived, and bore him a son.
text_la: Et abiit, et accepit Gomer, filiam Debelaim : et concepit, et peperit ei filium.
text_pt: Foi, pois, e tomou a Gômer, filha de Diblaim, e ela concebeu, e lhe deu um filho.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη καὶ ἔλαβεν τὴν Γομερ θυγατέρα Δεβηλαιμ καὶ συνέλαβεν καὶ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ υἱόν

text_en: And the Lord said to him: Call his name Jezrahel: for yet a little while, and I will visit the blood of Jezrahel upon the house of Jehu , and I will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel .
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad eum : Voca nomen ejus Jezrahel, quoniam adhuc modicum, et visitabo sanguinem Jezrahel super domum Jehu, et quiescere faciam regnum domus Israël.
text_pt: E disse-lhe o Senhor: Põe-lhe o nome de Jizreel; porque daqui a pouco visitarei o sangue de Jizreel sobre a casa de Jeú, e farei cessar o reino da casa de Israel.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς αὐτόν κάλεσον τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ιεζραελ διότι ἔτι μικρὸν καὶ ἐκδικήσω τὸ αἷμα τοῦ Ιεζραελ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ιου καὶ καταπαύσω βασιλείαν οἴκου Ισραηλ

text_en: And in that day I will break in pieces the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezrahel.
text_la: Et in illa die conteram arcum Israël in valle Jezrahel.
text_pt: E naquele dia quebrarei o arco de Israel no vale de Jizreel.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ συντρίψω τὸ τόξον τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι τοῦ Ιεζραελ

text_en: And she conceived again, and bore a daughter, and he said to him: Call her name , Without mercy: for I will not add any more to have mercy on the house of Israel , but I will utterly forget them.
text_la: Et concepit adhuc, et peperit filiam. Et dixit ei : Voca nomen ejus, Absque misericordia, quia non addam ultra misereri domui Israël, sed oblivione obliviscar eorum.
text_pt: E tornou ela a conceber, e deu à luz uma filha. E Deus disse: Põe-lhe o nome de Lo-Ruama; porque eu não tornarei mais a compadecer-me da casa de Israel, mas tudo lhe tirarei.
text_el: καὶ συνέλαβεν ἔτι καὶ ἔτεκεν θυγατέρα καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ κάλεσον τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς Οὐκ-ἠλεημένη διότι οὐ μὴ προσθήσω ἔτι ἐλεῆσαι τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Ισραηλ ἀλλ' ἢ ἀντιτασσόμενος ἀντιτάξομαι αὐτοῖς

text_en: And I will have mercy on the house of Juda , and I will save them by the Lord , their God : and I will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, nor by horses, nor by horsemen.
text_la: Et domui Juda miserebor, et salvabo eos in Domino Deo suo; et non salvabo eos in arcu et gladio, et in bello, et in equis, et in equitibus.
text_pt: Mas da casa de Judá me compadecerei, e os salvarei pelo Senhor seu Deus, pois não os salvarei pelo arco, nem pela espada, nem pela guerra, nem pelos cavalos, nem pelos cavaleiros.
text_el: τοὺς δὲ υἱοὺς Ιουδα ἐλεήσω καὶ σώσω αὐτοὺς ἐν κυρίῳ θεῷ αὐτῶν καὶ οὐ σώσω αὐτοὺς ἐν τόξῳ οὐδὲ ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ οὐδὲ ἐν πολέμῳ οὐδὲ ἐν ἅρμασιν οὐδὲ ἐν ἵπποις οὐδὲ ἐν ἱππεῦσιν

text_en: And she weaned her that was called Without mercy. And she conceived, and bore a son.
text_la: Et ablactavit eam quæ erat Absque misericordia. Et concepit, et peperit filium.
text_pt: E, depois de haver desmamado a Lo-Ruama, concebeu e deu à luz um filho.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεγαλάκτισεν τὴν Οὐκ-ἠλεημένην καὶ συνέλαβεν ἔτι καὶ ἔτεκεν υἱόν

text_en: And he said: Call his name , Not my people: for you are not my people, and I will not be yours.
text_la: Et dixit : Voca nomen ejus, Non populus meus, quia vos non populus meus, et ego non ero vester.
text_pt: E Deus disse: Põe-lhe o nome de Lo-Ami; porque vós não sois meu povo, nem eu serei vosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κάλεσον τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Οὐ-λαόσ-μου διότι ὑμεῖς οὐ λαός μου καὶ ἐγὼ οὔκ εἰμι ὑμῶν

text_en: And the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, that is without measure, and shall not be numbered. And it shall be in the place where it shall be said to them: You are not my people: it shall be said to them: You are the sons of the living God .
text_la: Et erit numerus filiorum Israël quasi arena maris, quæ sine mensura est, et non numerabitur. Et erit in loco ubi dicetur eis : Non populus meus vos : dicetur eis : Filii Dei viventis.
text_pt: Todavia o número dos filhos de Israel será como a areia do mar, que não pode medir-se nem contar-se; e acontecerá que no lugar onde se lhes dizia: Vós não sois meu povo, se lhes dirá: Vós sois filhos do Deus vivo.
text_el: καὶ ἦν ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ὡς ἡ ἄμμος τῆς θαλάσσης ἣ οὐκ ἐκμετρηθήσεται οὐδὲ ἐξαριθμηθήσεται καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῷ τόπῳ οὗ ἐρρέθη αὐτοῖς οὐ λαός μου ὑμεῖς ἐκεῖ κληθήσονται υἱοὶ θεοῦ ζῶντος

text_en: And the children of Juda , and the children of Israel , shall be gathered together: and they shall appoint themselves one head , and shall come up out of the land: for great is the day of Jezrahel.
text_la: Et congregabuntur filii Juda et filii Israël pariter; et ponent sibimet caput unum, et ascendent de terra, quia magnus dies Jezrahel.
text_pt: E os filhos de Judá e os filhos de Israel juntos se congregarão, e constituirão sobre si uma só cabeça, e subirão da terra; porque grande será o dia de Jizreel.
text_el: καὶ συναχθήσονται οἱ υἱοὶ Ιουδα καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ καὶ θήσονται ἑαυτοῖς ἀρχὴν μίαν καὶ ἀναβήσονται ἐκ τῆς γῆς ὅτι μεγάλη ἡ ἡμέρα τοῦ Ιεζραελ

text_en: Say to your brethren: You are my people: and to your sister: You have obtained mercy.
text_la: Dicite fratribus vestris : Populus meus; et sorori vestræ : Misericordiam consecuta.
text_pt: Dizei a vossos irmãos: Ami; e a vossas irmãs: Ruama.
text_el: εἴπατε τῷ ἀδελφῷ ὑμῶν Λαόσ-μου καὶ τῇ ἀδελφῇ ὑμῶν Ἠλεημένη

text_en: Judge your mother, judge her: because she is not my wife, and I am not her husband. Let her put away her fornications from her face, and her adulteries from between her breasts.
text_la: Judicate matrem vestram, judicate, quoniam ipsa non uxor mea, et ego non vir ejus. Auferat fornicationes suas a facie sua, et adulteria sua de medio uberum suorum;
text_pt: Contendei com vossa mãe, contendei, porque ela não é minha mulher, e eu não sou seu marido; e desvie ela as suas prostituições da sua vista e os seus adultérios de entre os seus seios.
text_el: κρίθητε πρὸς τὴν μητέρα ὑμῶν κρίθητε ὅτι αὐτὴ οὐ γυνή μου καὶ ἐγὼ οὐκ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς καὶ ἐξαρῶ τὴν πορνείαν αὐτῆς ἐκ προσώπου μου καὶ τὴν μοιχείαν αὐτῆς ἐκ μέσου μαστῶν αὐτῆς

text_en: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born: and I will make her as a wilderness , and will set her as a land that none can pass through and will kill her with drought.
text_la: ne forte expoliem eam nudam, et statuam eam secundum diem nativitatis suæ, et ponam eam quasi solitudinem, et statuam eam velut terram inviam, et interficiam eam siti.
text_pt: Para que eu não a despoje, ficando ela nua, e a ponha como no dia em que nasceu, e a faça como um deserto, e a torne como uma terra seca, e a mate à sede;
text_el: ὅπως ἂν ἐκδύσω αὐτὴν γυμνὴν καὶ ἀποκαταστήσω αὐτὴν καθὼς ἡμέρᾳ γενέσεως αὐτῆς καὶ θήσομαι αὐτὴν ὡς ἔρημον καὶ τάξω αὐτὴν ὡς γῆν ἄνυδρον καὶ ἀποκτενῶ αὐτὴν ἐν δίψει

text_en: And I will not have mercy on her children for they are the children of fornications.
text_la: Et filiorum illius non miserebor, quoniam filii fornicationum sunt.
text_pt: E não me compadeça de seus filhos, porque são filhos de prostituições.
text_el: καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῆς οὐ μὴ ἐλεήσω ὅτι τέκνα πορνείας ἐστίν

text_en: For their mother has committed fornication, she that conceived them is covered with shame: for she said: I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread, and my water, my wool, and my flax, my oil, and my drink.
text_la: Quia fornicata est mater eorum, confusa est quæ concepit eos; quia dixit : Vadam post amatores meos, qui dant panes mihi, et aquas meas, lanam meam, et linum meum, oleum meum, et potum meum.
text_pt: Porque sua mãe se prostituiu; aquela que os concebeu houve-se torpemente, porque diz: Irei atrás de meus amantes, que me dão o meu pão e a minha água, a minha lã e o meu linho, o meu óleo e as minhas bebidas.
text_el: ὅτι ἐξεπόρνευσεν ἡ μήτηρ αὐτῶν κατῄσχυνεν ἡ τεκοῦσα αὐτά εἶπεν γάρ ἀκολουθήσω ὀπίσω τῶν ἐραστῶν μου τῶν διδόντων μοι τοὺς ἄρτους μου καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ μου καὶ τὰ ἱμάτιά μου καὶ τὰ ὀθόνιά μου καὶ τὸ ἔλαιόν μου καὶ πάντα ὅσα μοι καθήκει

text_en: Wherefore, behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and I will stop it up with a wall, and she shall not find her paths.
text_la: Propter hoc ecce ego sepiam viam tuam spinis, et sepiam eam maceria, et semitas suas non inveniet.
text_pt: Portanto, eis que cercarei o teu caminho com espinhos; e levantarei um muro de sebe, para que ela não ache as suas veredas.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ φράσσω τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτῆς ἐν σκόλοψιν καὶ ἀνοικοδομήσω τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν τρίβον αὐτῆς οὐ μὴ εὕρῃ

text_en: And she shall follow after her lovers, and shall not overtake them: and she shall seek them, and shall not find, and she shall say: I will go, and return to my first husband: because it was better with me then than now.
text_la: Et sequetur amatores suos, et non apprehendet eos; et quæret eos, et non inveniet : et dicet : Vadam, et revertar ad virum meum priorem, quia bene mihi erat tunc magis quam nunc.
text_pt: Ela irá atrás de seus amantes, mas não os alcançará; e buscá-los-á, mas não os achará; então dirá: Ir-me-ei, e tornar-me-ei a meu primeiro marido, porque melhor me ia então do que agora.
text_el: καὶ καταδιώξεται τοὺς ἐραστὰς αὐτῆς καὶ οὐ μὴ καταλάβῃ αὐτούς καὶ ζητήσει αὐτοὺς καὶ οὐ μὴ εὕρῃ αὐτούς καὶ ἐρεῖ πορεύσομαι καὶ ἐπιστρέψω πρὸς τὸν ἄνδρα μου τὸν πρότερον ὅτι καλῶς μοι ἦν τότε ἢ νῦν

text_en: And she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver, and gold, which they have used in the service of Baal .
text_la: Et hæc nescivit, quia ego dedi ei frumentum, et vinum, et oleum, et argentum multiplicavi ei, et aurum, quæ fecerunt Baal.
text_pt: Ela, pois, não reconhece que eu lhe dei o grão, e o mosto, e o azeite, e que lhe multipliquei a prata e o ouro, que eles usaram para Baal.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὴ οὐκ ἔγνω ὅτι ἐγὼ δέδωκα αὐτῇ τὸν σῖτον καὶ τὸν οἶνον καὶ τὸ ἔλαιον καὶ ἀργύριον ἐπλήθυνα αὐτῇ αὐτὴ δὲ ἀργυρᾶ καὶ χρυσᾶ ἐποίησεν τῇ Βααλ

text_en: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in its season, and my wine in its season, and I will set at liberty my wool, and my flax, which covered her disgrace.
text_la: Idcirco convertar, et sumam frumentum meum in tempore suo, et vinum meum in tempore suo. Et liberabo lanam meam et linum meum, quæ operiebant ignominiam ejus.
text_pt: Portanto tornarei a tirar o meu grão a seu tempo e o meu mosto no seu tempo determinado; e arrebatarei a minha lã e o meu linho, com que cobriam a sua nudez.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐπιστρέψω καὶ κομιοῦμαι τὸν σῖτόν μου καθ' ὥραν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸν οἶνόν μου ἐν καιρῷ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀφελοῦμαι τὰ ἱμάτιά μου καὶ τὰ ὀθόνιά μου τοῦ μὴ καλύπτειν τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην αὐτῆς

text_en: And now I will lay open her folly in the eyes of her lovers: and no man shall deliver her out of my hand:
text_la: Et nunc revelabo stultitiam ejus in oculis amatorum ejus; et vir non eruet eam de manu mea;
text_pt: E agora descobrirei a sua vileza diante dos olhos dos seus amantes, e ninguém a livrará da minha mão.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἀποκαλύψω τὴν ἀκαθαρσίαν αὐτῆς ἐνώπιον τῶν ἐραστῶν αὐτῆς καὶ οὐδεὶς οὐ μὴ ἐξέληται αὐτὴν ἐκ χειρός μου

text_en: And I will cause all her mirth to cease, her solemnities , her new moons, her sabbaths , and all her festival times.
text_la: et cessare faciam omne gaudium ejus, solemnitatem ejus, neomeniam ejus, sabbatum ejus, et omnia festa tempora ejus.
text_pt: E farei cessar todo o seu gozo, as suas festas, as suas luas novas, e os seus sábados, e todas as suas festividades.
text_el: καὶ ἀποστρέψω πάσας τὰς εὐφροσύνας αὐτῆς ἑορτὰς αὐτῆς καὶ τὰς νουμηνίας αὐτῆς καὶ τὰ σάββατα αὐτῆς καὶ πάσας τὰς πανηγύρεις αὐτῆς

text_en: And I will destroy her vines, and her fig trees, of which she said: These are my rewards, which my lovers have given me: and I will make her as a forest and the beasts of the field shall devour her.
text_la: Et corrumpam vineam ejus, et ficum ejus, de quibus dixit : Mercedes hæ meæ sunt, quas dederunt mihi amatores mei; et ponam eam in saltum, et comedet eam bestia agri.
text_pt: E devastarei a sua vide e a sua figueira, de que ela diz: É esta a minha paga que me deram os meus amantes; eu, pois, farei delas um bosque, e as feras do campo as devorarão.
text_el: καὶ ἀφανιῶ ἄμπελον αὐτῆς καὶ τὰς συκᾶς αὐτῆς ὅσα εἶπεν μισθώματά μου ταῦτά ἐστιν ἃ ἔδωκάν μοι οἱ ἐρασταί μου καὶ θήσομαι αὐτὰ εἰς μαρτύριον καὶ καταφάγεται αὐτὰ τὰ θηρία τοῦ ἀγροῦ καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τὰ ἑρπετὰ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim , to whom she burnt incense , and decked herself out with her earrings, and with her jewels , and went after her lovers, and forgot me, says the Lord .
text_la: Et visitabo super eam dies Baalim, quibus accendebat incensum, et ornabatur in aure sua, et monili suo. Et ibat post amatores suos, et mei obliviscebatur, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Castigá-la-ei pelos dias dos Baalins, nos quais lhes queimou incenso, e se adornou dos seus pendentes e das suas jóias, e andou atrás de seus amantes, mas de mim se esqueceu, diz o SENHOR.
text_el: καὶ ἐκδικήσω ἐπ' αὐτὴν τὰς ἡμέρας τῶν Βααλιμ ἐν αἷς ἐπέθυεν αὐτοῖς καὶ περιετίθετο τὰ ἐνώτια αὐτῆς καὶ τὰ καθόρμια αὐτῆς καὶ ἐπορεύετο ὀπίσω τῶν ἐραστῶν αὐτῆς ἐμοῦ δὲ ἐπελάθετο λέγει κύριος

text_en: Therefore, behold I will allure her, and will lead her into the wilderness : and I will speak to her heart.
text_la: Propter hoc ecce ego lactabo eam, et ducam eam in solitudinem, et loquar ad cor ejus.
text_pt: Portanto, eis que eu a atrairei, e a levarei para o deserto, e lhe falarei ao coração.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ πλανῶ αὐτὴν καὶ τάξω αὐτὴν εἰς ἔρημον καὶ λαλήσω ἐπὶ τὴν καρδίαν αὐτῆς

text_en: And I will give her vinedressers out of the same place, and the valley of Achor for an opening of hope : and she shall sing there according to the days of her youth, and according to the days of her coming up out of the land of Egypt .
text_la: Et dabo ei vinitores ejus ex eodem loco, et vallem Achor, ad aperiendam spem; et canet ibi juxta dies juventutis suæ, et juxta dies ascensionis suæ de terra Ægypti.
text_pt: E lhe darei as suas vinhas dali, e o vale de Acor, por porta de esperança; e ali cantará, como nos dias de sua mocidade, e como no dia em que subiu da terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ δώσω αὐτῇ τὰ κτήματα αὐτῆς ἐκεῖθεν καὶ τὴν κοιλάδα Αχωρ διανοῖξαι σύνεσιν αὐτῆς καὶ ταπεινωθήσεται ἐκεῖ κατὰ τὰς ἡμέρας νηπιότητος αὐτῆς καὶ κατὰ τὰς ἡμέρας ἀναβάσεως αὐτῆς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And it shall be in that day, says the Lord : That she shall call me: My husband, and she shall call me no more Baali.
text_la: Et erit in die illa, ait Dominus : vocabit me, Vir meus, et non vocabit me ultra Baali.
text_pt: E naquele dia, diz o SENHOR, tu me chamarás: Meu marido; e não mais me chamarás: Meu senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ λέγει κύριος καλέσει με ὁ ἀνήρ μου καὶ οὐ καλέσει με ἔτι Βααλιμ

text_en: And I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and she shall no more remember their name .
text_la: Et auferam nomina Baalim de ore ejus, et non recordabitur ultra nominis eorum.
text_pt: E da sua boca tirarei os nomes dos Baalins, e não mais se lembrará desses nomes.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαρῶ τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν Βααλιμ ἐκ στόματος αὐτῆς καὶ οὐ μὴ μνησθῶσιν οὐκέτι τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν

text_en: And in that day I will make a covenant with them, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of the air, and with the creeping things of the earth: and I will destroy the bow, and the sword, and war out of the land: and I will make them sleep secure.
text_la: Et percutiam cum eis fœdus in die illa, cum bestia agri, et cum volucre cæli, et cum reptili terræ; et arcum, et gladium, et bellum conteram de terra, et dormire eos faciam fiducialiter.
text_pt: E naquele dia farei por eles aliança com as feras do campo, e com as aves do céu, e com os répteis da terra; e da terra quebrarei o arco, e a espada, e a guerra, e os farei deitar em segurança.
text_el: καὶ διαθήσομαι αὐτοῖς ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ διαθήκην μετὰ τῶν θηρίων τοῦ ἀγροῦ καὶ μετὰ τῶν πετεινῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ μετὰ τῶν ἑρπετῶν τῆς γῆς καὶ τόξον καὶ ῥομφαίαν καὶ πόλεμον συντρίψω ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς καὶ κατοικιῶ σε ἐπ' ἐλπίδι

text_en: And I will espouse you to me for ever: and I will espouse you to me in justice , and judgment , and in mercy, and in commiserations.
text_la: Et sponsabo te mihi in sempiternum; et sponsabo te mihi in justitia, et judicio, et in misericordia, et in miserationibus.
text_pt: E desposar-te-ei comigo para sempre; desposar-te-ei comigo em justiça, e em juízo, e em benignidade, e em misericórdias.
text_el: καὶ μνηστεύσομαί σε ἐμαυτῷ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ μνηστεύσομαί σε ἐμαυτῷ ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ἐν κρίματι καὶ ἐν ἐλέει καὶ ἐν οἰκτιρμοῖς

text_en: And I will espouse you to me in faith : and you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Et sponsabo te mihi in fide; et scies quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: E desposar-te-ei comigo em fidelidade, e conhecerás ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ μνηστεύσομαί σε ἐμαυτῷ ἐν πίστει καὶ ἐπιγνώσῃ τὸν κύριον

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day: I will hear, says the Lord , I will hear the heavens , and they shall hear the earth.
text_la: Et erit in die illa : exaudiam, dicit Dominus, exaudiam cælos, et illi exaudient terram.
text_pt: E acontecerá naquele dia que eu atenderei, diz o Senhor; eu atenderei aos céus, e estes atenderão à terra.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ λέγει κύριος ἐπακούσομαι τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ὁ οὐρανὸς ἐπακούσεται τῇ γῇ

text_en: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil, and these shall hear Jezrahel.
text_la: Et terra exaudiet triticum, et vinum, et oleum, et hæc exaudient Jezrahel.
text_pt: E a terra atenderá ao trigo, e ao mosto, e ao azeite, e estes atenderão a Jizreel.
text_el: καὶ ἡ γῆ ἐπακούσεται τὸν σῖτον καὶ τὸν οἶνον καὶ τὸ ἔλαιον καὶ αὐτὰ ἐπακούσεται τῷ Ιεζραελ

text_en: And I will sow her unto me in the earth, and I will have mercy on her that was without mercy.
text_la: Et seminabo eam mihi in terra, et miserebor ejus quæ fuit Absque misericordia.
text_pt: E semeá-la-ei para mim na terra, e compadecer-me-ei dela que não obteve misericórdia; e eu direi àquele que não era meu povo: Tu és meu povo; e ele dirá: Tu és meu Deus!
text_el: καὶ σπερῶ αὐτὴν ἐμαυτῷ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐλεήσω τὴν Οὐκ-ἠλεημένην

text_en: And I will say to that which was not my people: You are my people: and they shall say: You are my God .
text_la: Et dicam Non populo meo : Populus meus es tu; et ipse dicet : Deus meus es tu.
text_el: καὶ ἐρῶ τῷ Οὐ-λαῷ-μου λαός μου εἶ σύ καὶ αὐτὸς ἐρεῖ κύριος ὁ θεός μου εἶ σύ

text_en: And the Lord said to me: Go yet again, and love a woman beloved of her friend, and an adulteress : as the Lord loves the children of Israel , and they look to strange gods , and love the husks of the grapes.
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Adhuc vade, et dilige mulierem dilectam amico et adulteram, sicut diligit Dominus filios Israël, et ipsi respiciunt ad deos alienos, et diligunt vinacia uvarum.
text_pt: E o SENHOR me disse: Vai outra vez, ama uma mulher, amada de seu amigo, contudo adúltera, como o SENHOR ama os filhos de Israel, embora eles olhem para outros deuses, e amem os bolos de uvas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με ἔτι πορεύθητι καὶ ἀγάπησον γυναῖκα ἀγαπῶσαν πονηρὰ καὶ μοιχαλίν καθὼς ἀγαπᾷ ὁ θεὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ καὶ αὐτοὶ ἀποβλέπουσιν ἐπὶ θεοὺς ἀλλοτρίους καὶ φιλοῦσιν πέμματα μετὰ σταφίδων

text_en: And I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for a core of barley, and for half a core of barley.
text_la: Et fodi eam mihi quindecim argenteis, et coro hordei, et dimidio coro hordæi.
text_pt: E comprei-a para mim por quinze peças de prata, e um ômer, e meio ômer de cevada;
text_el: καὶ ἐμισθωσάμην ἐμαυτῷ πεντεκαίδεκα ἀργυρίου καὶ γομορ κριθῶν καὶ νεβελ οἴνου

text_en: And I said to her: You shall wait for me many days: you shall not play the harlot, and you shall be no man's , and I also will wait for you.
text_la: Et dixi ad eam : Dies multos exspectabis me; non fornicaberis, et non eris viro; sed et ego exspectabo te.
text_pt: E ele lhe disse: Tu ficarás comigo muitos dias; não te prostituirás, nem serás de outro homem; assim também eu esperarei por ti.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα πρὸς αὐτήν ἡμέρας πολλὰς καθήσῃ ἐπ' ἐμοὶ καὶ οὐ μὴ πορνεύσῃς οὐδὲ μὴ γένῃ ἀνδρὶ ἑτέρῳ καὶ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ σοί

text_en: For the children of Israel shall sit many days without king, and without prince, and without sacrifice , and without altar , and without ephod , and without theraphim.
text_la: Quia dies multos sedebunt filii Israël sine rege, et sine principe, et sine sacrificio, et sine altari, et sine ephod, et sine theraphim.
text_pt: Porque os filhos de Israel ficarão por muitos dias sem rei, e sem príncipe, e sem sacrifício, e sem estátua, e sem éfode ou terafim.
text_el: διότι ἡμέρας πολλὰς καθήσονται οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ οὐκ ὄντος βασιλέως οὐδὲ ὄντος ἄρχοντος οὐδὲ οὔσης θυσίας οὐδὲ ὄντος θυσιαστηρίου οὐδὲ ἱερατείας οὐδὲ δήλων

text_en: And after this the children of Israel shall return and shall seek the Lord , their God , and David, their king : and they shall fear the Lord , and his goodness , in the last days.
text_la: Et post hæc revertentur filii Israël, et quærent Dominum Deum suum, et David regem suum : et pavebunt ad Dominum, et ad bonum ejus, in novissimo dierum.
text_pt: Depois tornarão os filhos de Israel, e buscarão ao Senhor seu Deus, e a Davi, seu rei; e temerão ao Senhor, e à sua bondade, no fim dos dias.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἐπιστρέψουσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐπιζητήσουσιν κύριον τὸν θεὸν αὐτῶν καὶ Δαυιδ τὸν βασιλέα αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκστήσονται ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ ἐπὶ τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς αὐτοῦ ἐπ' ἐσχάτων τῶν ἡμερῶν

text_en: Hear the word of the Lord , you children of Israel , for the Lord shall enter into judgment with the inhabitants of the land: for there is no truth , and there is no mercy, and there is no knowledge of God in the land.
text_la: Audite verbum Domini, filii Israël, quia judicium Domino cum habitatoribus terræ : non est enim veritas, et non est misericordia, et non est scientia Dei in terra.
text_pt: Ouvi a palavra do SENHOR, vós filhos de Israel, porque o SENHOR tem uma contenda com os habitantes da terra; porque na terra não há verdade, nem benignidade, nem conhecimento de Deus.
text_el: ἀκούσατε λόγον κυρίου υἱοὶ Ισραηλ διότι κρίσις τῷ κυρίῳ πρὸς τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν γῆν διότι οὐκ ἔστιν ἀλήθεια οὐδὲ ἔλεος οὐδὲ ἐπίγνωσις θεοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: Cursing, and lying , and killing , and theft , and adultery , have overflowed, and blood has touched blood.
text_la: Maledictum, et mendacium, et homicidium, et furtum, et adulterium inundaverunt, et sanguis sanguinem tetigit.
text_pt: Só permanecem o perjurar, o mentir, o matar, o furtar e o adulterar; fazem violência, um ato sanguinário segue imediatamente a outro.
text_el: ἀρὰ καὶ ψεῦδος καὶ φόνος καὶ κλοπὴ καὶ μοιχεία κέχυται ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ αἵματα ἐφ' αἵμασιν μίσγουσιν

text_en: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwells in it shall languish with the heat of the field, and with the fowls of the air: yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be gathered together.
text_la: Propter hoc lugebit terra, et infirmabitur omnis qui habitat in ea, in bestia agri, et in volucre cæli; sed et pisces maris congregabuntur.
text_pt: Por isso a terra se lamentará, e qualquer que morar nela desfalecerá, com os animais do campo e com as aves do céu; e até os peixes do mar serão tirados.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο πενθήσει ἡ γῆ καὶ σμικρυνθήσεται σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν αὐτήν σὺν τοῖς θηρίοις τοῦ ἀγροῦ καὶ σὺν τοῖς ἑρπετοῖς τῆς γῆς καὶ σὺν τοῖς πετεινοῖς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ οἱ ἰχθύες τῆς θαλάσσης ἐκλείψουσιν

text_en: But yet let not any man judge: and let not a man be rebuked: for your people are as they that contradict the priest .
text_la: Verumtamen unusquisque non judicet, et non arguatur vir : populus enim tuus sicut hi qui contradicunt sacerdoti.
text_pt: Todavia ninguém contenda, ninguém repreenda, porque o teu povo é como os que contendem com o sacerdote.
text_el: ὅπως μηδεὶς μήτε δικάζηται μήτε ἐλέγχῃ μηδείς ὁ δὲ λαός μου ὡς ἀντιλεγόμενος ἱερεύς

text_en: And you shall fall today, and the prophet also shall fall with you: in the night I have made your mother to be silent.
text_la: Et corrues hodie, et corruet etiam propheta tecum. Nocte tacere feci matrem tuam.
text_pt: Por isso tropeçarás de dia, e o profeta contigo tropeçará de noite; e destruirei a tua mãe.
text_el: καὶ ἀσθενήσεις ἡμέρας καὶ ἀσθενήσει καὶ προφήτης μετὰ σοῦ νυκτὶ ὡμοίωσα τὴν μητέρα σου

text_en: My people have been silent, because they had no knowledge : because you have rejected knowledge , I will reject you, that you shall not do the office of priesthood to me: and you have forgotten the law of your God , I also will forget your children.
text_la: Conticuit populus meus, eo quod non habuerit scientiam : quia tu scientiam repulisti, repellam te, ne sacerdotio fungaris mihi; et oblita es legis Dei tui, obliviscar filiorum tuorum et ego.
text_pt: O meu povo foi destruído, porque lhe faltou o conhecimento; porque tu rejeitaste o conhecimento, também eu te rejeitarei, para que não sejas sacerdote diante de mim; e, visto que te esqueceste da lei do teu Deus, também eu me esquecerei de teus filhos.
text_el: ὡμοιώθη ὁ λαός μου ὡς οὐκ ἔχων γνῶσιν ὅτι σὺ ἐπίγνωσιν ἀπώσω κἀγὼ ἀπώσομαι σὲ τοῦ μὴ ἱερατεύειν μοι καὶ ἐπελάθου νόμον θεοῦ σου κἀγὼ ἐπιλήσομαι τέκνων σου

text_en: According to the multitude of them, so have they sinned against me: I will change their glory into shame.
text_la: Secundum multitudinem eorum sic peccaverunt mihi : gloriam eorum in ignominiam commutabo.
text_pt: Como eles se multiplicaram, assim pecaram contra mim; eu mudarei a sua honra em vergonha.
text_el: κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος αὐτῶν οὕτως ἥμαρτόν μοι τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν εἰς ἀτιμίαν θήσομαι

text_en: They shall eat the sins of my people, and shall lift up their souls to their iniquity .
text_la: Peccata populi mei comedent, et ad iniquitatem eorum sublevabunt animas eorum.
text_pt: Comem da oferta pelo pecado do meu povo, e pela transgressão dele têm desejo ardente.
text_el: ἁμαρτίας λαοῦ μου φάγονται καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἀδικίαις αὐτῶν λήμψονται τὰς ψυχὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: And there shall be like people like priest : and I will visit their ways upon them, and I will repay them their devices.
text_la: Et erit sicut populus, sic sacerdos; et visitabo super eum vias ejus, et cogitationes ejus reddam ei.
text_pt: Por isso, como é o povo, assim será o sacerdote; e castigá-lo-ei segundo os seus caminhos, e dar-lhe-ei a recompensa das suas obras.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται καθὼς ὁ λαὸς οὕτως καὶ ὁ ἱερεύς καὶ ἐκδικήσω ἐπ' αὐτὸν τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ διαβούλια αὐτοῦ ἀνταποδώσω αὐτῷ

text_en: And they shall eat and shall not be filled: they have committed fornication, and have not ceased: because they have forsaken the Lord in not observing the law .
text_la: Et comedent, et non saturabuntur; fornicati sunt, et non cessaverunt : quoniam Dominum dereliquerunt in non custodiendo.
text_pt: Comerão, mas não se fartarão; entregar-se-ão à luxúria, mas não se multiplicarão; porque deixaram de atentar ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ φάγονται καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐμπλησθῶσιν ἐπόρνευσαν καὶ οὐ μὴ κατευθύνωσιν διότι τὸν κύριον ἐγκατέλιπον τοῦ φυλάξαι

text_en: Fornication, and wine, and drunkenness , take away the understanding.
text_la: Fornicatio, et vinum, et ebrietas auferunt cor.
text_pt: A luxúria, e o vinho, e o mosto tiram o coração.
text_el: πορνείαν καὶ οἶνον καὶ μέθυσμα ἐδέξατο καρδία λαοῦ μου

text_en: My people have consulted their stocks, and their staff has declared unto them: for the spirit of fornication has deceived them, and they have committed fornication against their God .
text_la: Populus meus in ligno suo interrogavit, et baculus ejus annuntiavit ei; spiritus enim fornicationum decepit eos, et fornicati sunt a Deo suo.
text_pt: O meu povo consulta a sua madeira, e a sua vara lhe responde, porque o espírito da luxúria os engana, e prostituem-se, apartando-se da sujeição do seu Deus.
text_el: ἐν συμβόλοις ἐπηρώτων καὶ ἐν ῥάβδοις αὐτοῦ ἀπήγγελλον αὐτῷ πνεύματι πορνείας ἐπλανήθησαν καὶ ἐξεπόρνευσαν ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ αὐτῶν

text_en: They offered sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burnt incense upon the hills: under the oak, and the poplar, and the turpentine tree, because the shadow thereof was good : therefore shall your daughters commit fornication, and your spouses shall be adulteresses .
text_la: Super capita montium sacrificabant, et super colles ascendebant thymiama; subtus quercum, et populum, et terebinthum, quia bona erat umbra ejus; ideo fornicabuntur filiæ vestræ, et sponsæ vestræ adulteræ erunt.
text_pt: Sacrificam sobre os cumes dos montes, e queimam incenso sobre os outeiros, debaixo do carvalho, e do álamo, e do olmeiro, porque é boa a sua sombra; por isso vossas filhas se prostituem, e as vossas noras adulteram.
text_el: ἐπὶ τὰς κορυφὰς τῶν ὀρέων ἐθυσίαζον καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς βουνοὺς ἔθυον ὑποκάτω δρυὸς καὶ λεύκης καὶ δένδρου συσκιάζοντος ὅτι καλὸν σκέπη διὰ τοῦτο ἐκπορνεύσουσιν αἱ θυγατέρες ὑμῶν καὶ αἱ νύμφαι ὑμῶν μοιχεύσουσιν

text_en: I will not visit upon your daughters, when they shall commit fornication, and upon your spouses when they shall commit adultery : because themselves conversed with harlots, and offered sacrifice with the effeminate, and the people that does not understand shall be beaten.
text_la: Non visitabo super filias vestras cum fuerint fornicatæ, et super sponsas vestras cum adulteraverint, quoniam ipsi cum meretricibus conversabantur, et cum effeminatis sacrificabant; et populus non intelligens vapulabit.
text_pt: Eu não castigarei vossas filhas, quando se prostituem, nem vossas noras, quando adulteram; porque eles mesmos com as prostitutas se desviam, e com as meretrizes sacrificam; pois o povo que não tem entendimento será transtornado.
text_el: καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐπισκέψωμαι ἐπὶ τὰς θυγατέρας ὑμῶν ὅταν πορνεύωσιν καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς νύμφας ὑμῶν ὅταν μοιχεύωσιν διότι καὶ αὐτοὶ μετὰ τῶν πορνῶν συνεφύροντο καὶ μετὰ τῶν τετελεσμένων ἔθυον καὶ ὁ λαὸς ὁ συνίων συνεπλέκετο μετὰ πόρνης

text_en: If you play the harlot, O Israel , at least let not Juda offend : and go not into Galgal, and come not up into Bethaven, and do not swear : The Lord lives.
text_la: Si fornicaris tu, Israël, non delinquat saltem Juda; et nolite ingredi in Galgala, et ne ascenderitis in Bethaven, neque juraveritis : Vivit Dominus!
text_pt: Ainda que tu, ó Israel, queiras prostituir-te, contudo não se faça culpado Judá; não venhais a Gilgal, e não subais a Bete-Áven, e não jureis, dizendo: Vive o Senhor.
text_el: σὺ δέ Ισραηλ μὴ ἀγνόει καὶ Ιουδα μὴ εἰσπορεύεσθε εἰς Γαλγαλα καὶ μὴ ἀναβαίνετε εἰς τὸν οἶκον Ων καὶ μὴ ὀμνύετε ζῶντα κύριον

text_en: For Israel has gone astray like a wanton heifer now will the Lord feed them, as a lamb in a spacious place.
text_la: Quoniam sicut vacca lasciviens declinavit Israël; nunc pascet eos Dominus, quasi agnum in latitudine.
text_pt: Porque como uma novilha obstinada se rebelou Israel; agora o Senhor os apascentará como a um cordeiro num lugar espaçoso.
text_el: ὅτι ὡς δάμαλις παροιστρῶσα παροίστρησεν Ισραηλ νῦν νεμήσει αὐτοὺς κύριος ὡς ἀμνὸν ἐν εὐρυχώρῳ

text_en: Ephraim is a partaker with idols , let him alone.
text_la: Particeps idolorum Ephraim : dimitte eum.
text_pt: Efraim está entregue aos ídolos; deixa-o.
text_el: μέτοχος εἰδώλων Εφραιμ ἔθηκεν ἑαυτῷ σκάνδαλα

text_en: Their banquet is separated, they have gone astray by fornication: they that should have protected them have loved to bring shame upon them.
text_la: Separatum est convivium eorum; fornicatione fornicati sunt : dilexerunt afferre ignominiam protectores ejus.
text_pt: A sua bebida se foi; lançaram-se à luxúria continuamente; certamente os seus governadores amam a vergonha.
text_el: ᾑρέτισεν Χαναναίους πορνεύοντες ἐξεπόρνευσαν ἠγάπησαν ἀτιμίαν ἐκ φρυάγματος αὐτῶν

text_en: The wind has bound them up in its wings, and they shall be confounded because of their sacrifices .
text_la: Ligavit eum spiritus in alis suis, et confundentur a sacrificiis suis.
text_pt: Um vento os envolveu nas suas asas, e envergonhar-se-ão por causa dos seus sacrifícios.
text_el: συστροφὴ πνεύματος σὺ εἶ ἐν ταῖς πτέρυξιν αὐτῆς καὶ καταισχυνθήσονται ἐκ τῶν θυσιαστηρίων αὐτῶν

text_en: Hear this, O priests , and hearken, O you house of Israel , and give ear, O house of the king: for there is a judgment against you, because you have been a snare to them whom you should have watched over and a net spread upon Thabor .
text_la: Audite hoc, sacerdotes, et attendite, domus Israël, et domus regis, auscultate : quia vobis judicium est, quoniam laqueus facti estis speculationi, et rete expansum super Thabor.
text_pt: Ouvi isto, ó sacerdotes, e escutai, ó casa de Israel, e dai ouvidos, ó casa do rei, porque contra vós se dirige este juízo, visto que fostes um laço para Mizpá, e rede estendida sobre o Tabor.
text_el: ἀκούσατε ταῦτα οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ προσέχετε οἶκος Ισραηλ καὶ ὁ οἶκος τοῦ βασιλέως ἐνωτίζεσθε διότι πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐστιν τὸ κρίμα ὅτι παγὶς ἐγενήθητε τῇ σκοπιᾷ καὶ ὡς δίκτυον ἐκτεταμένον ἐπὶ τὸ ἰταβύριον

text_en: And you have turned aside victims into the depth and I am the teacher of them all.
text_la: Et victimas declinastis in profundum; et ego eruditor omnium eorum.
text_pt: Os revoltos se aprofundaram na matança; mas eu castigarei a todos eles.
text_el: ὃ οἱ ἀγρεύοντες τὴν θήραν κατέπηξαν ἐγὼ δὲ παιδευτὴς ὑμῶν

text_en: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me for now Ephraim has committed fornication, Israel is defiled.
text_la: Ego scio Ephraim, et Israël non est absconditus a me : quia nunc fornicatus est Ephraim; contaminatus est Israël.
text_pt: Eu conheço a Efraim, e Israel não se esconde de mim; porque agora te tens prostituído, ó Efraim, e Israel se contaminou.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἔγνων τὸν Εφραιμ καὶ Ισραηλ οὐκ ἄπεστιν ἀπ' ἐμοῦ διότι νῦν ἐξεπόρνευσεν Εφραιμ ἐμιάνθη Ισραηλ

text_en: They will not set their thoughts to return to their God : for the spirit of fornication is in the midst of them, and they have not known the Lord .
text_la: Non dabunt cogitationes suas ut revertantur ad Deum suum, quia spiritus fornicationum in medio eorum, et Dominum non cognoverunt.
text_pt: Não querem ordenar as suas ações a fim de voltarem para o seu Deus, porque o espírito das prostituições está no meio deles, e não conhecem ao Senhor.
text_el: οὐκ ἔδωκαν τὰ διαβούλια αὐτῶν τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι πρὸς τὸν θεὸν αὐτῶν ὅτι πνεῦμα πορνείας ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐστιν τὸν δὲ κύριον οὐκ ἐπέγνωσαν

text_en: And the pride of Israel shall answer in his face: and Israel , and Ephraim shall fall in their iniquity , Juda also shall fall with them.
text_la: Et respondebit arrogantia Israël in facie ejus, et Israël et Ephraim ruent in iniquitate sua : ruet etiam Judas cum eis.
text_pt: A soberba de Israel testificará no seu rosto; e Israel e Efraim cairão pela sua injustiça, e Judá cairá juntamente com eles.
text_el: καὶ ταπεινωθήσεται ἡ ὕβρις τοῦ Ισραηλ εἰς πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ καὶ Ισραηλ καὶ Εφραιμ ἀσθενήσουσιν ἐν ταῖς ἀδικίαις αὐτῶν καὶ ἀσθενήσει καὶ Ιουδας μετ' αὐτῶν

text_en: With their flocks and with their herds, they shall go to seek the Lord , and shall not find him: he is withdrawn from them.
text_la: In gregibus suis et in armentis suis vadent ad quærendum Dominum, et non invenient : ablatus est ab eis.
text_pt: Então irão com os seus rebanhos, e com o seu gado, para buscarem ao Senhor, mas não o acharão; ele se retirou deles.
text_el: μετὰ προβάτων καὶ μόσχων πορεύσονται τοῦ ἐκζητῆσαι τὸν κύριον καὶ οὐ μὴ εὕρωσιν αὐτόν ὅτι ἐξέκλινεν ἀπ' αὐτῶν

text_en: They have transgressed against the Lord : for they have begotten children that are strangers: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
text_la: In Dominum prævaricati sunt, quia filios alienos genuerunt : nunc devorabit eos mensis, cum partibus suis.
text_pt: Aleivosamente se houveram contra o Senhor, porque geraram filhos estranhos; agora em um só mês os consumirá com as suas porções.
text_el: ὅτι τὸν κύριον ἐγκατέλιπον ὅτι τέκνα ἀλλότρια ἐγεννήθησαν αὐτοῖς νῦν καταφάγεται αὐτοὺς ἡ ἐρυσίβη καὶ τοὺς κλήρους αὐτῶν

text_en: Blow the cornet in Gabaa, the trumpet in Rama: howl in Bethaven, behind your back, O Benjamin .
text_la: Clangite buccina in Gabaa, tuba in Rama; ululate in Bethaven, post tergum tuum, Benjamin.
text_pt: Tocai a buzina em Gibeá, a trombeta em Ramá; gritai altamente em Bete-Áven; depois de ti, ó Benjamim.
text_el: σαλπίσατε σάλπιγγι ἐπὶ τοὺς βουνούς ἠχήσατε ἐπὶ τῶν ὑψηλῶν κηρύξατε ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Ων ἐξέστη Βενιαμιν

text_en: Ephraim shall be in desolation in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel I have shown that which shall surely be.
text_la: Ephraim in desolatione erit in die correptionis; in tribubus Israël ostendi fidem.
text_pt: Efraim será para assolação no dia do castigo; entre as tribos de Israel manifestei o que está certo.
text_el: Εφραιμ εἰς ἀφανισμὸν ἐγένετο ἐν ἡμέραις ἐλέγχου ἐν ταῖς φυλαῖς τοῦ Ισραηλ ἔδειξα πιστά

text_en: The princes of Juda have become as they that take up the bound: I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
text_la: Facti sunt principes Juda quasi assumentes terminum; super eos effundam quasi aquam iram meam.
text_pt: Os príncipes de Judá são como os que mudam os limites; derramarei, pois, o meu furor sobre eles como água.
text_el: ἐγένοντο οἱ ἄρχοντες Ιουδα ὡς μετατιθέντες ὅρια ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἐκχεῶ ὡς ὕδωρ τὸ ὅρμημά μου

text_en: Ephraim is under oppression, and broken in judgment : because he began to go after filthiness.
text_la: Calumniam patiens est Ephraim, fractus judicio, quoniam cœpit abire post sordes.
text_pt: Efraim está oprimido e quebrantado no juízo, porque quis andar após o mandamento dos homens.
text_el: κατεδυνάστευσεν Εφραιμ τὸν ἀντίδικον αὐτοῦ κατεπάτησεν κρίμα ὅτι ἤρξατο πορεύεσθαι ὀπίσω τῶν ματαίων

text_en: And I will be like a moth to Ephraim: and like rottenness to the house of Juda .
text_la: Et ego quasi tinea Ephraim, et quasi putredo domui Juda.
text_pt: Portanto a Efraim serei como a traça, e para a casa de Judá como a podridão.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ ὡς ταραχὴ τῷ Εφραιμ καὶ ὡς κέντρον τῷ οἴκῳ Ιουδα

text_en: And Ephraim saw his sickness, and Juda his band: and Ephraim went to the Assyrian , and sent to the avenging king: and he shall not be able to heal you, neither shall he be able to take off the band from you.
text_la: Et vidit Ephraim languorem suum, et Juda vinculum suum; et abiit Ephraim ad Assur, et misit ad regem ultorem : et ipse non poterit sanare vos, nec solvere poterit a vobis vinculum.
text_pt: Quando Efraim viu a sua enfermidade, e Judá a sua chaga, subiu Efraim à Assíria e enviou ao rei Jarebe; mas ele não poderá sarar-vos, nem curar a vossa chaga.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Εφραιμ τὴν νόσον αὐτοῦ καὶ Ιουδας τὴν ὀδύνην αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπορεύθη Εφραιμ πρὸς Ἀσσυρίους καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρέσβεις πρὸς βασιλέα Ιαριμ καὶ αὐτὸς οὐκ ἠδυνάσθη ἰάσασθαι ὑμᾶς καὶ οὐ μὴ διαπαύσῃ ἐξ ὑμῶν ὀδύνη

text_en: For I will be like a lioness to Ephraim, and like a lion's whelp to the house of Juda : I, I will catch, and go: I will take away, and there is none that can rescue.
text_la: Quoniam ego quasi leæna Ephraim, et quasi catulus leonis domui Juda. Ego, ego capiam, et vadam; tollam, et non est qui eruat.
text_pt: Porque para Efraim serei como um leão, e como um leãozinho à casa de Judá: eu, eu o despedaçarei, e irme-ei embora; arrebatarei, e não haverá quem livre.
text_el: διότι ἐγώ εἰμι ὡς πανθὴρ τῷ Εφραιμ καὶ ὡς λέων τῷ οἴκῳ Ιουδα καὶ ἐγὼ ἁρπῶμαι καὶ πορεύσομαι καὶ λήμψομαι καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ ἐξαιρούμενος

text_en: I will go and return to my place: until you are consumed, and seek my face.
text_la: Vadens revertar ad locum meum, donec deficiatis, et quæratis faciem meam.
text_pt: Irei e voltarei ao meu lugar, até que se reconheçam culpados e busquem a minha face; estando eles angustiados, de madrugada me buscarão.
text_el: πορεύσομαι καὶ ἐπιστρέψω εἰς τὸν τόπον μου ἕως οὗ ἀφανισθῶσιν καὶ ἐπιζητήσουσιν τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἐν θλίψει αὐτῶν ὀρθριοῦσι πρός με λέγοντες

text_en: In their affliction they will rise early to me: Come, and let us return to the Lord .
text_la: In tribulatione sua mane consurgent ad me : Venite, et revertamur ad Dominum,
text_pt: Vinde, e tornemos ao SENHOR, porque ele despedaçou, e nos sarará; feriu, e nos atará a ferida.
text_el: πορευθῶμεν καὶ ἐπιστρέψωμεν πρὸς κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν ὅτι αὐτὸς ἥρπακεν καὶ ἰάσεται ἡμᾶς πατάξει καὶ μοτώσει ἡμᾶς

text_en: For he has taken us, and he will heal us: he will strike, and he will cure us.
text_la: quia ipse cepit, et sanabit nos; percutiet, et curabit nos.
text_pt: Depois de dois dias nos dará a vida; ao terceiro dia nos ressuscitará, e viveremos diante dele.
text_el: ὑγιάσει ἡμᾶς μετὰ δύο ἡμέρας ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ ἀναστησόμεθα καὶ ζησόμεθα ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ

text_en: He will revive us after two days: on the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight. We shall know , and we shall follow on, that we may know the Lord . His going forth is prepared as the morning light, and he will come to us as the early and the latter rain to the earth.
text_la: Vivificabit nos post duos dies; in die tertia suscitabit nos, et vivemus in conspectu ejus. Sciemus, sequemurque ut cognoscamus Dominum : quasi diluculum præparatus est egressus ejus, et veniet quasi imber nobis temporaneus et serotinus terræ.
text_pt: Então conheçamos, e prossigamos em conhecer ao Senhor; a sua saída, como a alva, é certa; e ele a nós virá como a chuva, como chuva serôdia que rega a terra.
text_el: καὶ γνωσόμεθα διώξομεν τοῦ γνῶναι τὸν κύριον ὡς ὄρθρον ἕτοιμον εὑρήσομεν αὐτόν καὶ ἥξει ὡς ὑετὸς ἡμῖν πρόιμος καὶ ὄψιμος τῇ γῇ

text_en: What shall I do to you, O Ephraim? What shall I do to you, O Juda ? Your mercy is as a morning cloud, and as the dew that goes away in the morning.
text_la: Quid faciam tibi, Ephraim? quid faciam tibi, Juda? misericordia vestra quasi nubes matutina, et quasi ros mane pertransiens.
text_pt: Que te farei, ó Efraim? Que te farei, ó Judá? Porque a vossa benignidade é como a nuvem da manhã e como o orvalho da madrugada, que cedo passa.
text_el: τί σοι ποιήσω Εφραιμ τί σοι ποιήσω Ιουδα τὸ δὲ ἔλεος ὑμῶν ὡς νεφέλη πρωινὴ καὶ ὡς δρόσος ὀρθρινὴ πορευομένη

text_en: For this reason have I hewed them by the prophets , I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and your judgments shall go forth as the light.
text_la: Propter hoc dolavi in prophetis; occidi eos in verbis oris mei : et judicia tua quasi lux egredientur.
text_pt: Por isso os abati pelos profetas; pelas palavras da minha boca os matei; e os teus juízos sairão como a luz,
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἀπεθέρισα τοὺς προφήτας ὑμῶν ἀπέκτεινα αὐτοὺς ἐν ῥήμασιν στόματός μου καὶ τὸ κρίμα μου ὡς φῶς ἐξελεύσεται

text_en: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice : and the knowledge of God more than holocausts .
text_la: Quia misericordiam volui, et non sacrificium; et scientiam Dei plus quam holocausta.
text_pt: Porque eu quero a misericórdia, e não o sacrifício; e o conhecimento de Deus, mais do que os holocaustos.
text_el: διότι ἔλεος θέλω καὶ οὐ θυσίαν καὶ ἐπίγνωσιν θεοῦ ἢ ὁλοκαυτώματα

text_en: But they, like Adam , have transgressed the covenant, there have they dealt treacherously against me.
text_la: Ipsi autem sicut Adam transgressi sunt pactum : ibi prævaricati sunt in me.
text_pt: Mas eles transgrediram a aliança, como Adão; eles se portaram aleivosamente contra mim.
text_el: αὐτοὶ δέ εἰσιν ὡς ἄνθρωπος παραβαίνων διαθήκην ἐκεῖ κατεφρόνησέν μου

text_en: Galaad is a city of workers of idols , supplanted with blood.
text_la: Galaad civitas operantium idolum, supplantata sanguine.
text_pt: Gileade é a cidade dos que praticam iniqüidade, manchada de sangue.
text_el: Γαλααδ πόλις ἐργαζομένη μάταια ταράσσουσα ὕδωρ

text_en: And like the jaws of highway robbers, they conspire with the priests who murder in the way those that pass out of Sichem : for they have wrought wickedness .
text_la: Et quasi fauces virorum latronum, particeps sacerdotum, in via interficientium pergentes de Sichem : quia scelus operati sunt.
text_pt: Como as hordas de salteadores que esperam alguns, assim é a companhia dos sacerdotes que matam no caminho num mesmo consenso; sim, eles cometem abominações.
text_el: καὶ ἡ ἰσχύς σου ἀνδρὸς πειρατοῦ ἔκρυψαν ἱερεῖς ὁδὸν κυρίου ἐφόνευσαν Σικιμα ὅτι ἀνομίαν ἐποίησαν

text_en: I have seen a horrible thing in the house of Israel : the fornications of Ephraim there: Israel is defiled.
text_la: In domo Israël vidi horrendum : ibi fornicationes Ephraim, contaminatus est Israël.
text_pt: Vejo uma coisa horrenda na casa de Israel, ali está a prostituição de Efraim; Israel está contaminado.
text_el: ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Ισραηλ εἶδον φρικώδη ἐκεῖ πορνείαν τοῦ Εφραιμ ἐμιάνθη Ισραηλ καὶ Ιουδα

text_en: And you also, O Juda , set you a harvest, when I shall bring back the captivity of my people.
text_la: Sed et Juda, pone messem tibi, cum convertero captivitatem populi mei.
text_pt: Também para ti, ó Judá, está assinada uma sega, quando eu trouxer o cativeiro do meu povo.
text_el: ἄρχου τρυγᾶν σεαυτῷ ἐν τῷ ἐπιστρέφειν με τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν τοῦ λαοῦ μου

text_en: When I would have healed Israel , the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria , for they have committed falsehood , and the thief has come in to steal , the robber is without.
text_la: Cum sanare vellem Israël, revelata est iniquitas Ephraim, et malitia Samariæ, quia operati sunt mendacium; et fur ingressus est spolians, latrunculus foris.
text_pt: Sarando eu a Israel, se descobriu a iniqüidade de Efraim, como também as maldades de Samaria, porque praticaram a falsidade; e o ladrão entra, e a horda dos salteadores despoja por fora.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἰάσασθαί με τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ ἀποκαλυφθήσεται ἡ ἀδικία Εφραιμ καὶ ἡ κακία Σαμαρείας ὅτι ἠργάσαντο ψευδῆ καὶ κλέπτης πρὸς αὐτὸν εἰσελεύσεται ἐκδιδύσκων λῃστὴς ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And lest they may say in their hearts, that I remember all their wickedness : their own devices now have beset them about, they have been done before my face.
text_la: Et ne forte dicant in cordibus suis, omnem malitiam eorum me recordatum, nunc circumdederunt eos adinventiones suæ : coram facie mea factæ sunt.
text_pt: E não dizem no seu coração que eu me lembro de toda a sua maldade; agora, pois, os cercam as suas obras; diante da minha face estão.
text_el: ὅπως συνᾴδωσιν ὡς συνᾴδοντες τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν πάσας τὰς κακίας αὐτῶν ἐμνήσθην νῦν ἐκύκλωσεν αὐτοὺς τὰ διαβούλια αὐτῶν ἀπέναντι τοῦ προσώπου μου ἐγένοντο

text_en: They have made the king glad with their wickedness : and the princes with their lies .
text_la: In malitia sua lætificaverunt regem, et in mendaciis suis principes.
text_pt: Com a sua malícia alegram ao rei, e com as suas mentiras aos príncipes.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς κακίαις αὐτῶν εὔφραναν βασιλεῖς καὶ ἐν τοῖς ψεύδεσιν αὐτῶν ἄρχοντας

text_en: They are all adulterers , like an oven heated by the baker: the city rested a little from the mingling of the leaven, till the whole was leavened.
text_la: Omnes adulterantes, quasi clibanus succensus a coquente; quievit paululum civitas a commistione fermenti, donec fermentaretur totum.
text_pt: Todos eles são adúlteros; são semelhantes ao forno aceso pelo padeiro, que cessa de mexer nas brasas, depois que amassou a massa, até que seja levedada.
text_el: πάντες μοιχεύοντες ὡς κλίβανος καιόμενος εἰς πέψιν κατακαύματος ἀπὸ τῆς φλογός ἀπὸ φυράσεως στέατος ἕως τοῦ ζυμωθῆναι αὐτό

text_en: The day of our king, the princes began to be mad with wine : he stretched out his hand with scorners.
text_la: Dies regis nostri : cœperunt principes furere a vino; extendit manum suam cum illusoribus.
text_pt: E no dia do nosso rei os príncipes se tornaram doentes com frascos de vinho; ele estendeu a sua mão com os escarnecedores.
text_el: αἱ ἡμέραι τῶν βασιλέων ὑμῶν ἤρξαντο οἱ ἄρχοντες θυμοῦσθαι ἐξ οἴνου ἐξέτεινεν τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ μετὰ λοιμῶν

text_en: Because they have applied their heart like an oven, when he laid snares for them: he slept all the night baking them, in the morning he himself was heated as a flaming fire.
text_la: Quia applicuerunt quasi clibanum cor suum, cum insidiaretur eis; tota nocte dormivit coquens eos : mane ipse succensus quasi ignis flammæ.
text_pt: Porque, prepararam o coração como um forno, na sua emboscada; toda a noite dorme o seu padeiro, pela manhã arde como fogo de chama.
text_el: διότι ἀνεκαύθησαν ὡς κλίβανος αἱ καρδίαι αὐτῶν ἐν τῷ καταράσσειν αὐτούς ὅλην τὴν νύκτα ὕπνου Εφραιμ ἐνεπλήσθη πρωὶ ἐγενήθη ἀνεκαύθη ὡς πυρὸς φέγγος

text_en: They were all heated like an oven, and have devoured their judges: all their kings have fallen: there is none amongst them that calls unto me.
text_la: Omnes calefacti sunt quasi clibanus, et devoraverunt judices suos : omnes reges eorum ceciderunt; non est qui clamat in eis ad me.
text_pt: Todos eles estão quentes como um forno, e consomem os seus juízes; todos os seus reis caem, ninguém entre eles há que me invoque.
text_el: πάντες ἐθερμάνθησαν ὡς κλίβανος καὶ κατέφαγον τοὺς κριτὰς αὐτῶν πάντες οἱ βασιλεῖς αὐτῶν ἔπεσαν οὐκ ἦν ὁ ἐπικαλούμενος ἐν αὐτοῖς πρός με

text_en: Ephraim himself is mixed among the nations : Ephraim has become as bread baked under the ashes, that is not turned.
text_la: Ephraim in populis ipse commiscebatur; Ephraim factus est subcinericius panis, qui non reversatur.
text_pt: Efraim se mistura com os povos; Efraim é um bolo que não foi virado.
text_el: Εφραιμ ἐν τοῖς λαοῖς αὐτοῦ συνανεμείγνυτο Εφραιμ ἐγένετο ἐγκρυφίας οὐ μεταστρεφόμενος

text_en: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knew it not: yea, grey hairs also are spread about upon him, and he is ignorant of it.
text_la: Comederunt alieni robur ejus, et ipse nescivit; sed et cani effusi sunt in eo, et ipse ignoravit.
text_pt: Estrangeiros lhe comeram a força, e ele não o sabe; também as cãs se espalharam sobre ele, e não o sabe.
text_el: κατέφαγον ἀλλότριοι τὴν ἰσχὺν αὐτοῦ αὐτὸς δὲ οὐκ ἐπέγνω καὶ πολιαὶ ἐξήνθησαν αὐτῷ καὶ αὐτὸς οὐκ ἔγνω

text_en: And the pride of Israel shall be humbled before his face: and they have not returned to the Lord their God , nor have they sought him in all these.
text_la: Et humiliabitur superbia Israël in facie ejus; nec reversi sunt ad Dominum Deum suum, et non quæsierunt eum in omnibus his.
text_pt: E a soberba de Israel testificará diante dele; todavia não voltarão para o Senhor seu Deus, nem o buscarão em tudo isto.
text_el: καὶ ταπεινωθήσεται ἡ ὕβρις Ισραηλ εἰς πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἐπέστρεψαν πρὸς κύριον τὸν θεὸν αὐτῶν καὶ οὐκ ἐξεζήτησαν αὐτὸν ἐν πᾶσι τούτοις

text_en: And Ephraim has become as a dove that is decoyed, not having a heart: they called upon Egypt , they went to the Assyrians .
text_la: Et factus est Ephraim quasi columba seducta non habens cor. Ægyptum invocabant; ad Assyrios abierunt.
text_pt: Porque Efraim é como uma pomba ingênua, sem entendimento; invocam o Egito, vão para a Assíria.
text_el: καὶ ἦν Εφραιμ ὡς περιστερὰ ἄνους οὐκ ἔχουσα καρδίαν Αἴγυπτον ἐπεκαλεῖτο καὶ εἰς Ἀσσυρίους ἐπορεύθησαν

text_en: And when they shall go, I will spread my net upon them: I will bring them down as the fowl of the air, I will strike them as their congregation has heard.
text_la: Et cum profecti fuerint, expandam super eos rete meum : quasi volucrem cæli detraham eos; cædam eos secundum auditionem cœtus eorum.
text_pt: Quando forem, sobre eles estenderei a minha rede, e como aves do céu os farei descer; castigá-los-ei, conforme o que eles têm ouvido na sua congregação.
text_el: καθὼς ἂν πορεύωνται ἐπιβαλῶ ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τὸ δίκτυόν μου καθὼς τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατάξω αὐτούς παιδεύσω αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἀκοῇ τῆς θλίψεως αὐτῶν

text_en: Woe to them, for they have departed from me: they shall be wasted because they have transgressed against me: and I redeemed them: and they have spoken lies against me.
text_la: Væ eis, quoniam recesserunt a me! vastabuntur, quia prævaricati sunt in me, et ego redemi eos, et ipsi locuti sunt contra me mendacia.
text_pt: Ai deles, porque fugiram de mim; destruição sobre eles, porque se rebelaram contra mim; eu os remi, mas disseram mentiras contra mim.
text_el: οὐαὶ αὐτοῖς ὅτι ἀπεπήδησαν ἀπ' ἐμοῦ δείλαιοί εἰσιν ὅτι ἠσέβησαν εἰς ἐμέ ἐγὼ δὲ ἐλυτρωσάμην αὐτούς αὐτοὶ δὲ κατελάλησαν κατ' ἐμοῦ ψεύδη

text_en: And they have not cried to me with their heart, but they howled in their beds: they have thought upon wheat and wine, they are departed from me.
text_la: Et non clamaverunt ad me in corde suo, sed ululabant in cubilibus suis : super triticum et vinum ruminabant; recesserunt a me.
text_pt: E não clamaram a mim com seu coração, mas davam uivos nas suas camas; para o trigo e para o vinho se ajuntam, mas contra mim se rebelam.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐβόησαν πρός με αἱ καρδίαι αὐτῶν ἀλλ' ἢ ὠλόλυζον ἐν ταῖς κοίταις αὐτῶν ἐπὶ σίτῳ καὶ οἴνῳ κατετέμνοντο ἐπαιδεύθησαν ἐν ἐμοί

text_en: And I have chastised them, and strengthened their arms: and they have imagined evil against me.
text_la: Et ego erudivi eos, et confortavi brachia eorum, et in me cogitaverunt malitiam.
text_pt: Eu os corrigi, e lhes esforcei os braços, mas pensam mal contra mim.
text_el: κἀγὼ κατίσχυσα τοὺς βραχίονας αὐτῶν καὶ εἰς ἐμὲ ἐλογίσαντο πονηρά

text_en: They returned, that they might be without yoke: they became like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword, for the rage of their tongue. This is their derision in the land of Egypt .
text_la: Reversi sunt ut essent absque jugo; facti sunt quasi arcus dolosus : cadent in gladio principes eorum, a furore linguæ suæ. Ista subsannatio eorum in terra Ægypti.
text_pt: Eles voltaram, mas não para o Altíssimo. Fizeram-se como um arco enganador; caem à espada os seus príncipes, por causa do furor da sua língua; este será o seu escárnio na terra do Egito.
text_el: ἀπεστράφησαν εἰς οὐθέν ἐγένοντο ὡς τόξον ἐντεταμένον πεσοῦνται ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ οἱ ἄρχοντες αὐτῶν δι' ἀπαιδευσίαν γλώσσης αὐτῶν οὗτος ὁ φαυλισμὸς αὐτῶν ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ

text_en: Let there be a trumpet in your throat: like an eagle upon the house of the Lord : because they have transgressed my covenant: and have violated my law .
text_la: In gutture tuo sit tuba quasi aquila super domum Domini, pro eo quod transgressi sunt fœdus meum, et legem meam prævaricati sunt.
text_pt: Põe a trombeta à tua boca. Ele virá como a águia contra a casa do SENHOR, porque transgrediram a minha aliança, e se rebelaram contra a minha lei.
text_el: εἰς κόλπον αὐτῶν ὡς γῆ ὡς ἀετὸς ἐπ' οἶκον κυρίου ἀνθ' ὧν παρέβησαν τὴν διαθήκην μου καὶ κατὰ τοῦ νόμου μου ἠσέβησαν

text_en: They shall call upon me: O my God , we, Israel , know you.
text_la: Me invocabunt : Deus meus, cognovimus te Israël.
text_pt: E a mim clamarão: Deus meu! Nós, Israel, te conhecemos.
text_el: ἐμὲ κεκράξονται ὁ θεός ἐγνώκαμέν σε

text_en: Israel has cast off the thing that is good , the enemy shall pursue him.
text_la: Projecit Israël bonum : inimicus persequetur eum.
text_pt: Israel rejeitou o bem; o inimigo persegui-lo-á.
text_el: ὅτι Ισραηλ ἀπεστρέψατο ἀγαθά ἐχθρὸν κατεδίωξαν

text_en: They have reigned, but not by me: they have been princes, and I knew not: of their silver and their gold they have made idols to themselves, that they might perish.
text_la: Ipsi regnaverunt, et non ex me; principes exstiterunt, et non cognovi : argentum suum et aurum suum fecerunt sibi idola, ut interirent.
text_pt: Eles fizeram reis, mas não por mim; constituíram príncipes, mas eu não o soube; da sua prata e do seu ouro fizeram ídolos para si, para serem destruídos.
text_el: ἑαυτοῖς ἐβασίλευσαν καὶ οὐ δι' ἐμοῦ ἦρξαν καὶ οὐκ ἐγνώρισάν μοι τὸ ἀργύριον αὐτῶν καὶ τὸ χρυσίον αὐτῶν ἐποίησαν ἑαυτοῖς εἴδωλα ὅπως ἐξολεθρευθῶσιν

text_en: Your calf, O Samaria , is cast off, my wrath is kindled against them. How long will they be incapable of being cleansed ?
text_la: Projectus est vitulus tuus, Samaria; iratus est furor meus in eos. Usquequo non poterunt emundari?
text_pt: O teu bezerro, ó Samaria, te rejeitou; a minha ira se acendeu contra eles; até quando serão eles incapazes da inocência?
text_el: ἀπότριψαι τὸν μόσχον σου Σαμάρεια παρωξύνθη ὁ θυμός μου ἐπ' αὐτούς ἕως τίνος οὐ μὴ δύνωνται καθαρισθῆναι

text_en: For itself also is the invention of Israel : a workman made it, and it is no god: for the calf of Samaria shall be turned to spiders' webs.
text_la: Quia ex Israël et ipse est : artifex fecit illum, et non est deus; quoniam in aranearum telas erit vitulus Samariæ.
text_pt: Porque isso vem de Israel, um artífice o fez, e não é Deus; mas em pedaços será desfeito o bezerro de Samaria.
text_el: ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ καὶ αὐτὸ τέκτων ἐποίησεν καὶ οὐ θεός ἐστιν διότι πλανῶν ἦν ὁ μόσχος σου Σαμάρεια

text_en: For they shall sow wind, and reap a whirlwind, there is no standing stalk in it, the bud shall yield no meal; and if it should yield, strangers shall eat it.
text_la: Quia ventum seminabunt, et turbinem metent : culmus stans non est in eo; germen non faciet farinam : quod etsi fecerit, alieni comedent eam.
text_pt: Porque semearam vento, e segarão tormenta, não haverá seara, a erva não dará farinha; se a der, tragá-la-ão os estrangeiros.
text_el: ὅτι ἀνεμόφθορα ἔσπειραν καὶ ἡ καταστροφὴ αὐτῶν ἐκδέξεται αὐτά δράγμα οὐκ ἔχον ἰσχὺν τοῦ ποιῆσαι ἄλευρον ἐὰν δὲ καὶ ποιήσῃ ἀλλότριοι καταφάγονται αὐτό

text_en: Israel is swallowed up: now is he become among the nations like an unclean vessel.
text_la: Devoratus est Israël; nunc factus est in nationibus quasi vas immundum.
text_pt: Israel foi devorado; agora está entre os gentios como um vaso em que ninguém tem prazer.
text_el: κατεπόθη Ισραηλ νῦν ἐγένετο ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ὡς σκεῦος ἄχρηστον

text_en: For they have gone up to Assyria , a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim has given gifts to his lovers.
text_la: Quia ipsi ascenderunt ad Assur, onager solitarius sibi; Ephraim munera dederunt amatoribus.
text_pt: Porque subiram à Assíria, como um jumento montês, por si só; Efraim mercou amores.
text_el: ὅτι αὐτοὶ ἀνέβησαν εἰς Ἀσσυρίους ἀνέθαλεν καθ' ἑαυτὸν Εφραιμ δῶρα ἠγάπησαν

text_en: But even though they shall have hired the nations , now will I gather them together: and they shall rest a while from the burden of the king, and the princes.
text_la: Sed et cum mercede conduxerint nationes, nunc congregabo eos, et quiescent paulisper ab onere regis et principum.
text_pt: Todavia, ainda que eles merquem entre as nações, eu os congregarei; e serão um pouco afligidos por causa da carga do rei dos príncipes.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο παραδοθήσονται ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν νῦν εἰσδέξομαι αὐτούς καὶ κοπάσουσιν μικρὸν τοῦ χρίειν βασιλέα καὶ ἄρχοντας

text_en: Because Ephraim has made many altars to sin : altars have become to him unto sin .
text_la: Quia multiplicavit Ephraim altaria ad peccandum; factæ sunt ei aræ in delictum.
text_pt: Porquanto Efraim multiplicou os altares para pecar; teve altares para pecar.
text_el: ὅτι ἐπλήθυνεν Εφραιμ θυσιαστήρια εἰς ἁμαρτίας ἐγένοντο αὐτῷ θυσιαστήρια ἠγαπημένα

text_en: I shall write to him my manifold laws, which have been accounted as foreign.
text_la: Scribam ei multiplices leges meas, quæ velut alienæ computatæ sunt.
text_pt: Escrevi-lhe as grandezas da minha lei, porém essas são estimadas como coisa estranha.
text_el: καταγράψω αὐτῷ πλῆθος καὶ τὰ νόμιμα αὐτοῦ εἰς ἀλλότρια ἐλογίσθησαν θυσιαστήρια τὰ ἠγαπημένα

text_en: They shall offer victims, they shall sacrifice flesh, and shall eat it, and the Lord will not receive them: now will he remember their iniquity , and will visit their sins : they shall return to Egypt .
text_la: Hostias offerent, immolabunt carnes et comedent, et Dominus non suscipiet eas : nunc recordabitur iniquitatis eorum, et visitabit peccata eorum : ipsi in Ægyptum convertentur.
text_pt: Quanto aos sacrifícios das minhas ofertas, sacrificam carne, e a comem, mas o Senhor não as aceita; agora se lembrará da sua iniqüidade, e punirá os seus pecados; eles voltarão para o Egito.
text_el: διότι ἐὰν θύσωσιν θυσίαν καὶ φάγωσιν κρέα κύριος οὐ προσδέξεται αὐτά νῦν μνησθήσεται τὰς ἀδικίας αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκδικήσει τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν αὐτοὶ εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἀπέστρεψαν καὶ ἐν Ἀσσυρίοις ἀκάθαρτα φάγονται

text_en: And Israel has forgotten his Maker , and has built temples : and Juda has built many fenced cities: and I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the houses thereof.
text_la: Et oblitus est Israël factoris sui, et ædificavit delubra; et Judas multiplicavit urbes munitas; et mittam ignem in civitates ejus, et devorabit ædes illius.
text_pt: Porque Israel se esqueceu do seu Criador, e edificou templos, e Judá multiplicou cidades fortificadas. Mas eu enviarei um fogo contra as suas cidades, que consumirá os seus palácios.
text_el: καὶ ἐπελάθετο Ισραηλ τοῦ ποιήσαντος αὐτὸν καὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν τεμένη καὶ Ιουδας ἐπλήθυνεν πόλεις τετειχισμένας καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ πῦρ εἰς τὰς πόλεις αὐτοῦ καὶ καταφάγεται τὰ θεμέλια αὐτῶν

text_en: Rejoice not, O Israel : rejoice not as the nations do: for you have committed fornication against your God , you have loved a reward upon every cornfloor.
text_la: Noli lætari, Israël; noli exsultare sicut populi : quia fornicatus es a Deo tuo; dilexisti mercedem super omnes areas tritici.
text_pt: Não te alegres, ó Israel, não exultes, como os povos; porque ao prostituir-te abandonaste o teu Deus; amaste a paga de meretriz sobre todas as eiras de trigo.
text_el: μὴ χαῖρε Ισραηλ μηδὲ εὐφραίνου καθὼς οἱ λαοί διότι ἐπόρνευσας ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ σου ἠγάπησας δόματα ἐπὶ πάντα ἅλωνα σίτου

text_en: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the wine shall deceive them.
text_la: Area et torcular non pascet eos, et vinum mentietur eis :
text_pt: A eira e o lagar não os manterão; e o mosto lhes faltará.
text_el: ἅλων καὶ ληνὸς οὐκ ἔγνω αὐτούς καὶ ὁ οἶνος ἐψεύσατο αὐτούς

text_en: They shall not dwell in the Lord's land: Ephraim is returned to Egypt , and has eaten unclean things among the Assyrians .
text_la: non habitabunt in terra Domini. Reversus est Ephraim in Ægyptum, et in Assyriis pollutum comedit.
text_pt: Na terra do Senhor não permanecerão; mas Efraim tornará ao Egito, e na Assíria comerão comida imunda.
text_el: οὐ κατῴκησαν ἐν τῇ γῇ τοῦ κυρίου κατῴκησεν Εφραιμ εἰς Αἴγυπτον καὶ ἐν Ἀσσυρίοις ἀκάθαρτα φάγονται

text_en: They shall not offer wine to the Lord , neither shall they please him: their sacrifices shall be like the bread of mourners: all that shall eat it shall be defiled: for their bread is life for their soul , it shall not enter into the house of the Lord .
text_la: Non libabunt Domino vinum, et non placebunt ei. Sacrificia eorum quasi panis lugentium; omnes qui comedent eum, contaminabuntur : quia panis eorum animæ ipsorum : non intrabit in domum Domini.
text_pt: Não derramarão libações de vinho ao Senhor, nem lhe agradarão as suas ofertas. Os seus sacrifícios lhes serão como pão de pranteadores; todos os que dele comerem serão imundos, porque o seu pão será somente para si mesmos; não entrará na casa do Senhor.
text_el: οὐκ ἔσπεισαν τῷ κυρίῳ οἶνον καὶ οὐχ ἥδυναν αὐτῷ αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν ὡς ἄρτος πένθους αὐτοῖς πάντες οἱ ἔσθοντες αὐτὰ μιανθήσονται διότι οἱ ἄρτοι αὐτῶν ταῖς ψυχαῖς αὐτῶν οὐκ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὸν οἶκον κυρίου

text_en: What will you do in the solemn day, in the day of the feast of the Lord ?
text_la: Quid facietis in die solemni, in die festivitatis Domini?
text_pt: Que fareis vós no dia da solenidade, e no dia da festa do Senhor?
text_el: τί ποιήσετε ἐν ἡμέρᾳ πανηγύρεως καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἑορτῆς τοῦ κυρίου

text_en: For behold they have gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them together, Memphis shall bury them: nettles shall inherit their beloved silver, the bur shall be in their tabernacles.
text_la: Ecce enim profecti sunt a vastitate : Ægyptus congregabit eos; Memphis sepeliet eos : desiderabile argentum eorum urtica hæreditabit, lappa in tabernaculis eorum.
text_pt: Porque, eis que eles se foram por causa da destruição, mas o Egito os recolherá, Mênfis os sepultará; o desejável da sua prata as urtigas o possuirão por herança, espinhos crescerão nas suas tendas.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ πορεύσονται ἐκ ταλαιπωρίας Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐκδέξεται αὐτοὺς Μέμφις καὶ θάψει αὐτοὺς Μαχμας τὸ ἀργύριον αὐτῶν ὄλεθρος κληρονομήσει ἄκανθαι ἐν τοῖς σκηνώμασιν αὐτῶν

text_en: The days of visitation have come, the days of repaying have come: know , O Israel , that the prophet was foolish, the spiritual man was mad , for the multitude of your iniquity , and the multitude of your madness .
text_la: Venerunt dies visitationis, venerunt dies retributionis. Scitote, Israël, stultum prophetam, insanum virum spiritualem, propter multitudinem iniquitatis tuæ, et multitudinem amentiæ.
text_pt: Chegarão os dias da punição, chegarão os dias da retribuição; Israel o saberá; o profeta é um insensato, o homem de espírito é um louco; por causa da abundância da tua iniqüidade também haverá grande ódio.
text_el: ἥκασιν αἱ ἡμέραι τῆς ἐκδικήσεως ἥκασιν αἱ ἡμέραι τῆς ἀνταποδόσεώς σου καὶ κακωθήσεται Ισραηλ ὥσπερ ὁ προφήτης ὁ παρεξεστηκώς ἄνθρωπος ὁ πνευματοφόρος ὑπὸ τοῦ πλήθους τῶν ἀδικιῶν σου ἐπληθύνθη μανία σου

text_en: The watchman of Ephraim was with my God : the prophet has become a snare of ruin upon all his ways, madness is in the house of his God .
text_la: Speculator Ephraim cum Deo meo, propheta laqueus ruinæ factus est super omnes vias ejus; insania in domo Dei ejus.
text_pt: Efraim era o vigia com o meu Deus, mas o profeta é como um laço de caçador de aves em todos os seus caminhos, e ódio na casa do seu Deus.
text_el: σκοπὸς Εφραιμ μετὰ θεοῦ προφήτης παγὶς σκολιὰ ἐπὶ πάσας τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ μανίαν ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου κατέπηξαν

text_en: They have sinned deeply, as in the days of Gabaa: he will remember their iniquity , and will visit their sin .
text_la: Profunde peccaverunt, sicut in diebus Gabaa. Recordabitur iniquitatis eorum, et visitabit peccata eorum.
text_pt: Muito profundamente se corromperam, como nos dias de Gibeá; ele lembrar-se-á das suas injustiças, visitará os pecados deles.
text_el: ἐφθάρησαν κατὰ τὰς ἡμέρας τοῦ βουνοῦ μνησθήσεται ἀδικίας αὐτοῦ ἐκδικήσει ἁμαρτίας αὐτοῦ

text_en: I found Israel like grapes in the desert , I saw their fathers like the firstfruits of the fig tree in the top thereof: but they went in to Beelphegor , and alienated themselves to that confusion, and became abominable, as those things were, which they loved .
text_la: Quasi uvas in deserto inveni Israël, quasi prima poma ficulneæ in cacumine ejus vidi patres eorum : ipsi autem intraverunt ad Beelphegor, et abalienati sunt in confusionem, et facti sunt abominabiles sicut ea quæ dilexerunt.
text_pt: Achei a Israel como uvas no deserto, vi a vossos pais como a fruta temporã da figueira no seu princípio; mas eles foram para Baal-Peor, e se consagraram a essa vergonha, e se tornaram abomináveis como aquilo que amaram.
text_el: ὡς σταφυλὴν ἐν ἐρήμῳ εὗρον τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ ὡς σκοπὸν ἐν συκῇ πρόιμον εἶδον πατέρας αὐτῶν αὐτοὶ εἰσῆλθον πρὸς τὸν Βεελφεγωρ καὶ ἀπηλλοτριώθησαν εἰς αἰσχύνην καὶ ἐγένοντο οἱ ἠγαπημένοι ὡς οἱ ἐβδελυγμένοι

text_en: As for Ephraim, their glory has flown away like a bird from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.
text_la: Ephraim quasi avis avolavit; gloria eorum a partu, et ab utero, et a conceptu.
text_pt: Quanto a Efraim, a sua glória como ave voará, não haverá nascimento, não haverá gestação nem concepção.
text_el: Εφραιμ ὡς ὄρνεον ἐξεπετάσθη αἱ δόξαι αὐτῶν ἐκ τόκων καὶ ὠδίνων καὶ συλλήμψεων

text_en: And though they should bring up their children, I will make them without children among men : yea, and woe to them, when I shall depart from them.
text_la: Quod etsi enutrierint filios suos, absque liberis eos faciam in hominibus; sed et væ eis cum recessero ab eis!
text_pt: Ainda que venham a criar seus filhos, contudo os privarei deles para que não fique nenhum homem. Ai deles, quando deles eu me apartar!
text_el: διότι καὶ ἐὰν ἐκθρέψωσιν τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν ἀτεκνωθήσονται ἐξ ἀνθρώπων διότι καὶ οὐαὶ αὐτοῖς ἐστιν σάρξ μου ἐξ αὐτῶν

text_en: Ephraim, as I saw, was a Tyre , founded in beauty: and Ephraim shall bring out his children to the murderer .
text_la: Ephraim, ut vidi, Tyrus erat fundata in pulchritudine; et Ephraim educet ad interfectorem filios suos.
text_pt: Efraim, assim como vi a Tiro, está plantado num lugar aprazível; mas Efraim levará os seus filhos ao matador.
text_el: Εφραιμ ὃν τρόπον εἶδον εἰς θήραν παρέστησαν τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν καὶ Εφραιμ τοῦ ἐξαγαγεῖν εἰς ἀποκέντησιν τὰ τέκνα αὐτοῦ

text_en: Give them, O Lord . What will you give them? Give them a womb without children, and dry breasts.
text_la: Da eis, Domine. Quid dabis eis? da eis vulvam sine liberis, et ubera arentia.
text_pt: Dá-lhes, ó Senhor; mas que lhes darás? Dá-lhes uma madre que aborte e seios secos.
text_el: δὸς αὐτοῖς κύριε τί δώσεις αὐτοῖς δὸς αὐτοῖς μήτραν ἀτεκνοῦσαν καὶ μαστοὺς ξηρούς

text_en: All their wickedness is in Galgal, for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their devices I will cast them forth out of my house: I will love them no more, all their princes are revolters.
text_la: Omnes nequitiæ eorum in Galgal, quia ibi exosos habui eos. Propter malitiam adinventionum eorum, de domo mea ejiciam eos; non addam ut diligam eos : omnes principes eorum recedentes.
text_pt: Toda a sua malícia se acha em Gilgal, porque ali os odiei; por causa da maldade das suas obras lançá-los-ei para fora de minha casa. Não os amarei mais; todos os seus príncipes são rebeldes.
text_el: πᾶσαι αἱ κακίαι αὐτῶν εἰς Γαλγαλ ὅτι ἐκεῖ αὐτοὺς ἐμίσησα διὰ τὰς κακίας τῶν ἐπιτηδευμάτων αὐτῶν ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου μου ἐκβαλῶ αὐτούς οὐ μὴ προσθήσω τοῦ ἀγαπῆσαι αὐτούς πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες αὐτῶν ἀπειθοῦντες

text_en: Ephraim is struck, their root is dried up, they shall yield no fruit. And if they should have issue, I will slay the best beloved fruit of their womb.
text_la: Percussus est Ephraim; radix eorum exsiccata est : fructum nequaquam facient, quod etsi genuerint, interficiam amantissima uteri eorum.
text_pt: Efraim foi ferido, secou-se a sua raiz; não darão fruto; sim, ainda que gerem, matarei os frutos desejáveis do seu ventre.
text_el: ἐπόνεσεν Εφραιμ τὰς ῥίζας αὐτοῦ ἐξηράνθη καρπὸν οὐκέτι μὴ ἐνέγκῃ διότι καὶ ἐὰν γεννήσωσιν ἀποκτενῶ τὰ ἐπιθυμήματα κοιλίας αὐτῶν

text_en: My God will cast them away, because they hearkened not to him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations .
text_la: Abjiciet eos Deus meus, quia non audierunt eum, et erunt vagi in nationibus.
text_pt: O meu Deus os rejeitará, porque não o ouviram, e errantes andarão entre as nações.
text_el: ἀπώσεται αὐτοὺς ὁ θεός ὅτι οὐκ εἰσήκουσαν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσονται πλανῆται ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν

text_en: Israel a vine full of branches, the fruit is agreeable to it: according to the multitude of his fruit, he has multiplied altars , according to the plenty of his land he has abounded with idols .
text_la: Vitis frondosa Israël, fructus adæquatus est ei : secundum multitudinem fructus sui multiplicavit altaria, juxta ubertatem terræ suæ exuberavit simulacris.
text_pt: Israel é uma vide estéril que dá fruto para si mesmo; conforme a abundância do seu fruto, multiplicou também os altares; conforme a bondade da sua terra, assim, fizeram boas as estátuas.
text_el: ἄμπελος εὐκληματοῦσα Ισραηλ ὁ καρπὸς αὐτῆς εὐθηνῶν κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν καρπῶν αὐτοῦ ἐπλήθυνεν τὰ θυσιαστήρια κατὰ τὰ ἀγαθὰ τῆς γῆς αὐτοῦ ᾠκοδόμησεν στήλας

text_en: Their heart is divided: now they shall perish: he shall break down their idols , he shall destroy their altars .
text_la: Divisum est cor eorum, nunc interibunt; ipse confringet simulacra eorum, depopulabitur aras eorum.
text_pt: O seu coração está dividido, por isso serão culpados; o Senhor demolirá os seus altares, e destruirá as suas estátuas.
text_el: ἐμέρισαν καρδίας αὐτῶν νῦν ἀφανισθήσονται αὐτὸς κατασκάψει τὰ θυσιαστήρια αὐτῶν ταλαιπωρήσουσιν αἱ στῆλαι αὐτῶν

text_en: For now they shall say: We have no king: because we fear not the Lord : and what shall a king do to us?
text_la: Quia nunc dicent : Non est rex nobis, non enim timemus Dominum; et rex quid faciet nobis?
text_pt: Certamente agora dirão: Não temos rei, porque não tememos ao Senhor; e o rei, que faria por nós?
text_el: διότι νῦν ἐροῦσιν οὐκ ἔστιν βασιλεὺς ἡμῖν ὅτι οὐκ ἐφοβήθημεν τὸν κύριον ὁ δὲ βασιλεὺς τί ποιήσει ἡμῖν

text_en: You speak words of an unprofitable vision , and you shall make a covenant: and judgment shall spring up as bitterness in the furrows of the field.
text_la: Loquimini verba visionis inutilis, et ferietis fœdus; et germinabit quasi amaritudo judicium super sulcos agri.
text_pt: Falaram palavras, jurando falsamente, fazendo uma aliança; por isso florescerá o juízo como erva peçonhenta nos sulcos dos campos.
text_el: λαλῶν ῥήματα προφάσεις ψευδεῖς διαθήσεται διαθήκην ἀνατελεῖ ὡς ἄγρωστις κρίμα ἐπὶ χέρσον ἀγροῦ

text_en: The inhabitants of Samaria have worshipped the kine of Bethaven: for the people thereof have mourned over it, and the wardens of its temple that rejoiced over it in its glory because it is departed from it.
text_la: Vaccas Bethaven coluerunt habitatores Samariæ; quia luxit super eum populus ejus, et æditui ejus super eum exsultaverunt in gloria ejus, quia migravit ab eo.
text_pt: Os moradores de Samaria serão atemorizados pelo bezerro de Bete-«ven; porque o seu povo se lamentará por causa dele, como também os seus sacerdotes idólatras que nele se regozijavam, por causa da sua glória, que se apartou dela.
text_el: τῷ μόσχῳ τοῦ οἴκου Ων παροικήσουσιν οἱ κατοικοῦντες Σαμάρειαν ὅτι ἐπένθησεν ὁ λαὸς αὐτοῦ ἐπ' αὐτόν καὶ καθὼς παρεπίκραναν αὐτόν ἐπιχαροῦνται ἐπὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ ὅτι μετῳκίσθη ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: For itself also is carried into Assyria , a present to the avenging king: shame shall fall upon Ephraim, and Israel shall be confounded in his own will .
text_la: Siquidem et ipse in Assur delatus est, munus regi ultori. Confusio Ephraim capiet, et confundetur Israël in voluntate sua.
text_pt: Também será levada para a Assíria como um presente ao rei Jarebe; Efraim ficará confuso, e Israel se envergonhará por causa do seu próprio conselho.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸν εἰς Ἀσσυρίους δήσαντες ἀπήνεγκαν ξένια τῷ βασιλεῖ Ιαριμ ἐν δόματι Εφραιμ δέξεται καὶ αἰσχυνθήσεται Ισραηλ ἐν τῇ βουλῇ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Samaria has made her king to pass as froth upon the face of the water.
text_la: Transire fecit Samaria regem suum quasi spumam super faciem aquæ.
text_pt: O rei de Samaria será desfeito como a espuma sobre a face da água.
text_el: ἀπέρριψεν Σαμάρεια βασιλέα αὐτῆς ὡς φρύγανον ἐπὶ προσώπου ὕδατος

text_en: And the high places of the idol , the sin of Israel shall be destroyed: the bur and the thistle shall grow up over their altars : and they shall say to the mountains Cover us; and to the hills: Fall upon us.
text_la: Et disperdentur excelsa idoli, peccatum Israël; lappa et tribulus ascendet super aras eorum : et dicent montibus : Operite nos, et collibus : Cadite super nos.
text_pt: E os altos de Áven, pecado de Israel, serão destruídos; espinhos e cardos crescerão sobre os seus altares; e dirão aos montes: Cobri-nos! E aos outeiros: Caí sobre nós!
text_el: καὶ ἐξαρθήσονται βωμοὶ Ων ἁμαρτήματα τοῦ Ισραηλ ἄκανθαι καὶ τρίβολοι ἀναβήσονται ἐπὶ τὰ θυσιαστήρια αὐτῶν καὶ ἐροῦσιν τοῖς ὄρεσιν καλύψατε ἡμᾶς καὶ τοῖς βουνοῖς πέσατε ἐφ' ἡμᾶς

text_en: From the days of Gabaa, Israel has sinned , there they stood: the battle in Gabaa against the children of iniquity shall not overtake them.
text_la: Ex diebus Gabaa peccavit Israël; ibi steterunt. Non comprehendet eos in Gabaa prælium super filios iniquitatis.
text_pt: Desde os dias de Gibeá pecaste, ó Israel; ali permaneceram; a peleja em Gibeá, contra os filhos da perversidade, não os alcançará.
text_el: ἀφ' οὗ οἱ βουνοί ἥμαρτεν Ισραηλ ἐκεῖ ἔστησαν οὐ μὴ καταλάβῃ αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ βουνῷ πόλεμος ἐπὶ τὰ τέκνα ἀδικίας

text_en: According to my desire, I will chastise them: and the nations shall be gathered together against them, when they shall be chastised for their two iniquities .
text_la: Juxta desiderium meum corripiam eos : congregabuntur super eos populi, cum corripientur propter duas iniquitates suas.
text_pt: Eu os castigarei na medida do meu desejo; e congregar-se-ão contra eles os povos, quando eu os atar pela sua dupla transgressão.
text_el: ἦλθεν παιδεῦσαι αὐτούς καὶ συναχθήσονται ἐπ' αὐτοὺς λαοὶ ἐν τῷ παιδεύεσθαι αὐτοὺς ἐν ταῖς δυσὶν ἀδικίαις αὐτῶν

text_en: Ephraim is a heifer taught to love to tread out corn, but I passed over upon the beauty of her neck: I will ride upon Ephraim, Juda shall plough, Jacob shall break the furrows for himself.
text_la: Ephraim vitula docta diligere trituram, et ego transivi super pulchritudinem colli ejus : ascendam super Ephraim, arabit Judas; confringet sibi sulcos Jacob.
text_pt: Porque Efraim é uma bezerra domada, que gosta de trilhar; e eu poupava a formosura do seu pescoço; mas farei cavalgar Efraim. Judá lavrará, Jacó lhe desfará os torrões.
text_el: Εφραιμ δάμαλις δεδιδαγμένη ἀγαπᾶν νεῖκος ἐγὼ δὲ ἐπελεύσομαι ἐπὶ τὸ κάλλιστον τοῦ τραχήλου αὐτῆς ἐπιβιβῶ Εφραιμ καὶ παρασιωπήσομαι Ιουδαν ἐνισχύσει αὐτῷ Ιακωβ

text_en: Sow for yourselves in justice , and reap in the mouth of mercy, break up your fallow ground: but the time to seek the Lord is, when he shall come that shall teach you justice .
text_la: Seminate vobis in justitia, et metite in ore misericordiæ. Innovate vobis novale; tempus autem requirendi Dominum, cum venerit qui docebit vos justitiam.
text_pt: Semeai para vós em justiça, ceifai segundo a misericórdia; lavrai o campo de lavoura; porque é tempo de buscar ao Senhor, até que venha e chova a justiça sobre vós.
text_el: σπείρατε ἑαυτοῖς εἰς δικαιοσύνην τρυγήσατε εἰς καρπὸν ζωῆς φωτίσατε ἑαυτοῖς φῶς γνώσεως ἐκζητήσατε τὸν κύριον ἕως τοῦ ἐλθεῖν γενήματα δικαιοσύνης ὑμῖν

text_en: You have ploughed wickedness , you have reaped iniquity , you have eaten the fruit of lying : because you have trusted in your ways, in the multitude of your strong ones.
text_la: Arastis impietatem, iniquitatem messuistis : comedistis frugem mendacii, quia confisus es in viis tuis, in multitudine fortium tuorum.
text_pt: Lavrastes a impiedade, segastes a iniqüidade, e comestes o fruto da mentira; porque confiaste no teu caminho, na multidão dos teus poderosos.
text_el: ἵνα τί παρεσιωπήσατε ἀσέβειαν καὶ τὰς ἀδικίας αὐτῆς ἐτρυγήσατε ἐφάγετε καρπὸν ψευδῆ ὅτι ἤλπισας ἐν τοῖς ἅρμασίν σου ἐν πλήθει δυνάμεώς σου
