text_en: A tumult shall arise among your people: and all your fortresses shall be destroyed as Salmana was destroyed, by the house of him that judged Baal in the day of battle, the mother being dashed in pieces upon her children.
text_la: Consurget tumultus in populo tuo; et omnes munitiones tuæ vastabuntur, sicut vastatus est Salmana a domo ejus qui judicavit Baal in die prælii, matre super filios allisa.
text_pt: Portanto, entre o teu povo se levantará um grande tumulto, e todas as tuas fortalezas serão destruídas, como Salmã destruiu a Bete-Arbel no dia da guerra; a mãe ali foi despedaçada com os filhos.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαναστήσεται ἀπώλεια ἐν τῷ λαῷ σου καὶ πάντα τὰ περιτετειχισμένα σου οἰχήσεται ὡς ἄρχων Σαλαμαν ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου Ιεροβααλ ἐν ἡμέραις πολέμου μητέρα ἐπὶ τέκνοις ἠδάφισαν

text_en: So has Bethel done to you, because of the evil of your iniquities .
text_la: Sic fecit vobis Bethel, a facie malitiæ nequitiarum vestrarum.
text_pt: Assim vos fará Betel por causa da vossa grande malícia; de madrugada o rei de Israel será totalmente destruído.
text_el: οὕτως ποιήσω ὑμῖν οἶκος τοῦ Ισραηλ ἀπὸ προσώπου κακιῶν ὑμῶν ὄρθρου ἀπερρίφησαν ἀπερρίφη βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ

text_en: As the morning passes, so has the king of Israel passed away. Because Israel was a child, and I loved him: and I called my son out of Egypt .
text_la: Sicut mane transiit, pertransiit rex Israël. Quia puer Israël, et dilexi eum; et ex Ægypto vocavi filium meum.
text_pt: Quando Israel era menino, eu o amei; e do Egito chamei a meu filho.
text_el: διότι νήπιος Ισραηλ καὶ ἐγὼ ἠγάπησα αὐτὸν καὶ ἐξ Αἰγύπτου μετεκάλεσα τὰ τέκνα αὐτοῦ

text_en: As they called them, they went away from before their face: they offered victims to Baalim , and sacrificed to idols .
text_la: Vocaverunt eos, sic abierunt a facie eorum; Baalim immolabant, et simulacris sacrificabant.
text_pt: Mas, como os chamavam, assim se iam da sua face; sacrificavam a baalins, e queimavam incenso às imagens de escultura.
text_el: καθὼς μετεκάλεσα αὐτούς οὕτως ἀπῴχοντο ἐκ προσώπου μου αὐτοὶ τοῖς Βααλιμ ἔθυον καὶ τοῖς γλυπτοῖς ἐθυμίων

text_en: And I was like a foster father to Ephraim, I carried them in my arms: and they knew not that I healed them.
text_la: Et ego quasi nutritius Ephraim : portabam eos in brachiis meis, et nescierunt quod curarem eos.
text_pt: Todavia, eu ensinei a andar a Efraim; tomando-os pelos seus braços, mas não entenderam que eu os curava.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ συνεπόδισα τὸν Εφραιμ ἀνέλαβον αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸν βραχίονά μου καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν ὅτι ἴαμαι αὐτούς

text_en: I will draw them with the cords of Adam , with the bands of love : and I will be to them as one that takes off the yoke on their jaws: and I put his meat to him that he might eat.
text_la: In funiculis Adam traham eos, in vinculis caritatis; et ero eis quasi exaltans jugum super maxillas eorum, et declinavi ad eum ut vesceretur.
text_pt: Atraí-os com cordas humanas, com laços de amor, e fui para eles como os que tiram o jugo de sobre as suas queixadas, e lhes dei mantimento.
text_el: ἐν διαφθορᾷ ἀνθρώπων ἐξέτεινα αὐτοὺς ἐν δεσμοῖς ἀγαπήσεώς μου καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς ὡς ῥαπίζων ἄνθρωπος ἐπὶ τὰς σιαγόνας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπιβλέψομαι πρὸς αὐτόν δυνήσομαι αὐτῷ

text_en: He shall not return into the land of Egypt , but the Assyrian shall be his king: because they would not be converted .
text_la: Non revertetur in terram Ægypti, et Assur ipse rex ejus, quoniam noluerunt converti.
text_pt: Não voltará para a terra do Egito, mas a Assíria será seu rei; porque recusam converter-se.
text_el: κατῴκησεν Εφραιμ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ Ασσουρ αὐτὸς βασιλεὺς αὐτοῦ ὅτι οὐκ ἠθέλησεν ἐπιστρέψαι

text_en: The sword has begun in his cities, and it shall consume his chosen men , and shall devour their heads.
text_la: Cœpit gladius in civitatibus ejus, et consumet electos ejus, et comedet capita eorum.
text_pt: E cairá a espada sobre as suas cidades, e consumirá os seus ramos, e os devorará, por causa dos seus próprios conselhos.
text_el: καὶ ἠσθένησεν ῥομφαία ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ κατέπαυσεν ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτοῦ καὶ φάγονται ἐκ τῶν διαβουλίων αὐτῶν

text_en: And my people shall long for my return: but a yoke shall be put upon them together, which shall not be taken off.
text_la: Et populus meus pendebit ad reditum meum; jugum autem imponetur eis simul, quod non auferetur.
text_pt: Porque o meu povo é inclinado a desviar-se de mim; ainda que chamam ao Altíssimo, nenhum deles o exalta.
text_el: καὶ ὁ λαὸς αὐτοῦ ἐπικρεμάμενος ἐκ τῆς κατοικίας αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ θεὸς ἐπὶ τὰ τίμια αὐτοῦ θυμωθήσεται καὶ οὐ μὴ ὑψώσῃ αὐτόν

text_en: How shall I deal with you, O Ephraim, shall I protect you, O Israel ? How shall I make you as Adama, shall I set you as Seboim? my heart is turned within me, my repentance is stirred up.
text_la: Quomodo dabo te, Ephraim? protegam te, Israël? Quomodo dabo te sicut Adama, ponam te ut Seboim? Conversum est in me cor meum, pariter conturbata est pœnitudo mea.
text_pt: Como te deixaria, ó Efraim? Como te entregaria, ó Israel? Como te faria como Admá? Te poria como Zeboim? Está comovido em mim o meu coração, as minhas compaixões à uma se acendem.
text_el: τί σε διαθῶ Εφραιμ ὑπερασπιῶ σου Ισραηλ τί σε διαθῶ ὡς Αδαμα θήσομαί σε καὶ ὡς Σεβωιμ μετεστράφη ἡ καρδία μου ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ συνεταράχθη ἡ μεταμέλειά μου

text_en: I will not execute the fierceness of my wrath : I will not return to destroy Ephraim: because I am God , and not man : the holy one in the midst of you, and I will not enter into the city.
text_la: Non faciam furorem iræ meæ; non convertar ut disperdam Ephraim, quoniam Deus ego, et non homo; in medio tui sanctus, et non ingrediar civitatem.
text_pt: Não executarei o furor da minha ira; não voltarei para destruir a Efraim, porque eu sou Deus e não homem, o Santo no meio de ti; eu não entrarei na cidade.
text_el: οὐ μὴ ποιήσω κατὰ τὴν ὀργὴν τοῦ θυμοῦ μου οὐ μὴ ἐγκαταλίπω τοῦ ἐξαλειφθῆναι τὸν Εφραιμ διότι θεὸς ἐγώ εἰμι καὶ οὐκ ἄνθρωπος ἐν σοὶ ἅγιος καὶ οὐκ εἰσελεύσομαι εἰς πόλιν

text_en: They shall walk after the Lord , he shall roar as a lion: because he shall roar, and the children of the sea shall fear .
text_la: Post Dominum ambulabunt; quasi leo rugiet, quia ipse rugiet, et formidabunt filii maris.
text_pt: Andarão após o Senhor; ele rugirá como leão; rugindo, pois, ele, os filhos do ocidente tremerão.
text_el: ὀπίσω κυρίου πορεύσομαι ὡς λέων ἐρεύξεται ὅτι αὐτὸς ὠρύσεται καὶ ἐκστήσονται τέκνα ὑδάτων

text_en: And they shall fly away like a bird out of Egypt , and like a dove out of the land of the Assyrians : and I will place them in their own houses, says the Lord .
text_la: Et avolabunt quasi avis ex Ægypto, et quasi columba de terra Assyriorum : et collocabo eos in domibus suis, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Tremendo virão como um passarinho, os do Egito, e como uma pomba os da terra da Assíria, e os farei habitar em suas casas, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐκστήσονται ὡς ὄρνεον ἐξ Αἰγύπτου καὶ ὡς περιστερὰ ἐκ γῆς Ἀσσυρίων καὶ ἀποκαταστήσω αὐτοὺς εἰς τοὺς οἴκους αὐτῶν λέγει κύριος

text_en: Ephraim has compassed me about with denials, and the house of Israel with deceit : but Juda went down as a witness with God , and is faithful with the saints .
text_la: Circumdedit me in negatione Ephraim, et in dolo domus Israël; Judas autem testis descendit cum Deo, et cum sanctis fidelis.
text_pt: Efraim me cercou com mentira, e a casa de Israel com engano; mas Judá ainda domina com Deus, e com os santos está fiel.
text_el: ἐκύκλωσέν με ἐν ψεύδει Εφραιμ καὶ ἐν ἀσεβείαις οἶκος Ισραηλ καὶ Ιουδα νῦν ἔγνω αὐτοὺς ὁ θεός καὶ λαὸς ἅγιος κεκλήσεται θεοῦ

text_en: Ephraim feeds on the wind, and follows the burning heat: all the day long he multiplied lies and desolation: and he has made a covenant with the Assyrians , and carried oil into Egypt .
text_la: Ephraim pascit ventum, et sequitur æstum; tota die mendacium et vastitatem multiplicat : et fœdus cum Assyriis iniit, et oleum in Ægyptum ferebat.
text_pt: Efraim se apascenta de vento, e segue o vento leste; todo o dia multiplica a mentira e a destruição; e fazem aliança com a Assíria, e o azeite se leva ao Egito.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Εφραιμ πονηρὸν πνεῦμα ἐδίωξεν καύσωνα ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν κενὰ καὶ μάταια ἐπλήθυνεν καὶ διαθήκην μετὰ Ἀσσυρίων διέθετο καὶ ἔλαιον εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἐνεπορεύετο

text_en: Therefore there is a judgment of the Lord with Juda , and a visitation for Jacob : he will render to him according to his ways, and according to his devices.
text_la: Judicium ergo Domini cum Juda, et visitatio super Jacob : juxta vias ejus, et juxta adinventiones ejus reddet ei.
text_pt: O Senhor também com Judá tem contenda, e castigará Jacó segundo os seus caminhos; segundo as suas obras o recompensará.
text_el: καὶ κρίσις τῷ κυρίῳ πρὸς Ιουδαν τοῦ ἐκδικῆσαι τὸν Ιακωβ κατὰ τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ κατὰ τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα αὐτοῦ ἀνταποδώσει αὐτῷ

text_en: In the womb he supplanted his brother: and by his strength he had success with an angel .
text_la: In utero supplantavit fratrem suum, et in fortitudine sua directus est cum angelo.
text_pt: No ventre pegou do calcanhar de seu irmão, e na sua força lutou com Deus.
text_el: ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ ἐπτέρνισεν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν κόποις αὐτοῦ ἐνίσχυσεν πρὸς θεὸν

text_en: And he prevailed over the angel , and was strengthened: he wept, and made supplication to him: he found him in Bethel , and there he spoke with us.
text_la: Et invaluit ad angelum, et confortatus est; flevit, et rogavit eum. In Bethel invenit eum, et ibi locutus est nobiscum.
text_pt: Lutou com o anjo, e prevaleceu; chorou, e lhe suplicou; em Betel o achou, e ali falou conosco,
text_el: καὶ ἐνίσχυσεν μετὰ ἀγγέλου καὶ ἠδυνάσθη ἔκλαυσαν καὶ ἐδεήθησάν μου ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Ων εὕροσάν με καὶ ἐκεῖ ἐλαλήθη πρὸς αὐτόν

text_en: Even the Lord God of hosts , the Lord is his memorial.
text_la: Et Dominus Deus exercituum, Dominus memoriale ejus.
text_pt: Sim, o Senhor, o Deus dos Exércitos; o Senhor é o seu memorial.
text_el: ὁ δὲ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ ἔσται μνημόσυνον αὐτοῦ

text_en: Therefore turn to your God : keep mercy and judgment, and hope in your God always.
text_la: Et tu ad Deum tuum converteris; misericordiam et judicium custodi, et spera in Deo tuo semper.
text_pt: Tu, pois, converte-te a teu Deus; guarda a benevolência e o juízo, e em teu Deus espera sempre.
text_el: καὶ σὺ ἐν θεῷ σου ἐπιστρέψεις ἔλεον καὶ κρίμα φυλάσσου καὶ ἔγγιζε πρὸς τὸν θεόν σου διὰ παντός

text_en: He is like Chanaan , there is a deceitful balance in his hand, he has loved oppression.
text_la: Chanaan, in manu ejus statera dolosa, calumniam dilexit.
text_pt: É um mercador; tem nas mãos uma balança enganosa; ama a opressão.
text_el: Χανααν ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ ζυγὸς ἀδικίας καταδυναστεύειν ἠγάπησε

text_en: And Ephraim said: But yet I have become rich, I have found me an idol : all my labours shall not find me the iniquity that I have committed.
text_la: Et dixit Ephraim : Verumtamen dives effectus sum; inveni idolum mihi : omnes labores mei non invenient mihi iniquitatem quam peccavi.
text_pt: E diz Efraim: Contudo me tenho enriquecido, e tenho adquirido para mim grandes bens; em todo o meu trabalho não acharão em mim iniqüidade alguma que seja pecado.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Εφραιμ πλὴν πεπλούτηκα εὕρηκα ἀναψυχὴν ἐμαυτῷ πάντες οἱ πόνοι αὐτοῦ οὐχ εὑρεθήσονται αὐτῷ δι' ἀδικίας ἃς ἥμαρτεν

text_en: And I that am the Lord your God from the land of Egypt , will yet cause you to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the feast .
text_la: Et ego Dominus Deus tuus ex terra Ægypti : adhuc sedere te faciam in tabernaculis, sicut in diebus festivitatis.
text_pt: Mas eu sou o Senhor teu Deus desde a terra do Egito; eu ainda te farei habitar em tendas, como nos dias da festa solene.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἀνήγαγόν σε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ἔτι κατοικιῶ σε ἐν σκηναῖς καθὼς ἡμέρᾳ ἑορτῆς

text_en: And I have spoken by the prophets , and I have multiplied visions , and I have used similitudes by the ministry of the prophets .
text_la: Et locutus sum super prophetas, et ego visionem multiplicavi, et in manu prophetarum assimilatus sum.
text_pt: Falei aos profetas, e multipliquei a visão; e pelo ministério dos profetas propus símiles.
text_el: καὶ λαλήσω πρὸς προφήτας καὶ ἐγὼ ὁράσεις ἐπλήθυνα καὶ ἐν χερσὶν προφητῶν ὡμοιώθην

text_en: If Galaad be an idol , then in vain were they in Galgal offering sacrifices with bullocks: for their altars also are as heaps in the furrows of the field.
text_la: Si Galaad idolum, ergo frustra erant in Galgal bobus immolantes; nam et altaria eorum quasi acervi super sulcos agri.
text_pt: Não é Gileade iniqüidade? Pura vaidade são eles; em Gilgal sacrificam bois; os seus altares são como montões de pedras nos sulcos dos campos.
text_el: εἰ μὴ Γαλααδ ἔστιν ἄρα ψευδεῖς ἦσαν ἐν Γαλγαλ ἄρχοντες θυσιάζοντες καὶ τὰ θυσιαστήρια αὐτῶν ὡς χελῶναι ἐπὶ χέρσον ἀγροῦ

text_en: Jacob fled into the country of Syria , and Israel served for a wife, and was a keeper for a wife.
text_la: Fugit Jacob in regionem Syriæ, et servivit Israël in uxorem, et in uxorem servavit.
text_pt: Jacó fugiu para o campo da Síria, e Israel serviu por uma mulher, e por uma mulher guardou o gado.
text_el: καὶ ἀνεχώρησεν Ιακωβ εἰς πεδίον Συρίας καὶ ἐδούλευσεν Ισραηλ ἐν γυναικὶ καὶ ἐν γυναικὶ ἐφυλάξατο

text_en: But the Lord by a prophet brought Israel out of Egypt : and he was preserved by a prophet .
text_la: In propheta autem eduxit Dominus Israël de Ægypto, et in propheta servatus est.
text_pt: Mas o Senhor por meio de um profeta fez subir a Israel do Egito, e por um profeta foi ele guardado.
text_el: καὶ ἐν προφήτῃ ἀνήγαγεν κύριος τὸν Ισραηλ ἐξ Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐν προφήτῃ διεφυλάχθη

text_en: Ephraim has provoked me to wrath with his bitterness, and his blood shall come upon him, and his Lord will render his reproach unto him.
text_la: Ad iracundiam me provocavit Ephraim in amaritudinibus suis : et sanguis ejus super eum veniet, et opprobrium ejus restituet ei Dominus suus.
text_pt: Efraim mui amargosamente provocou a sua ira; portanto deixará ficar sobre ele o seu sangue, e o seu Senhor o recompensará pelo seu opróbrio.
text_el: ἐθύμωσεν Εφραιμ καὶ παρώργισεν καὶ τὸ αἷμα αὐτοῦ ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἐκχυθήσεται καὶ τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν αὐτοῦ ἀνταποδώσει αὐτῷ κύριος

text_en: When Ephraim spoke, a horror seized Israel : and he sinned in Baal , and died.
text_la: Loquente Ephraim, horror invasit Israël; et deliquit in Baal, et mortuus est.
text_pt: Quando Efraim falava, tremia-se; foi exaltado em Israel; mas ele se fez culpado em Baal, e morreu.
text_el: κατὰ τὸν λόγον Εφραιμ δικαιώματα αὐτὸς ἔλαβεν ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ καὶ ἔθετο αὐτὰ τῇ Βααλ καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And now they have sinned more and more: and they have made to themselves a molten thing of their silver as the likeness of idols : the whole is the work of craftsmen: to these that say: Sacrifice men , you that adore calves.
text_la: Et nunc addiderunt ad peccandum; feceruntque sibi conflatile de argento suo quasi similitudinem idolorum : factura artificum totum est : his ipsi dicunt : Immolate homines, vitulos adorantes.
text_pt: E agora multiplicaram pecados, e da sua prata fizeram uma imagem de fundição, ídolos segundo o seu entendimento, todos obra de artífices, dos quais dizem: Os homens que sacrificam beijem os bezerros.
text_el: καὶ προσέθετο τοῦ ἁμαρτάνειν ἔτι καὶ ἐποίησαν ἑαυτοῖς χώνευμα ἐκ τοῦ ἀργυρίου αὐτῶν κατ' εἰκόνα εἰδώλων ἔργα τεκτόνων συντετελεσμένα αὐτοῖς αὐτοὶ λέγουσιν θύσατε ἀνθρώπους μόσχοι γὰρ ἐκλελοίπασιν

text_en: Therefore they shall be as a morning cloud, and as the early dew that passes away, as the dust that is driven with a whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.
text_la: Idcirco erunt quasi nubes matutina, et sicut ros matutinus præteriens; sicut pulvis turbine raptus ex area, et sicut fumus de fumario.
text_pt: Por isso serão como a nuvem da manhã, e como o orvalho da madrugada, que cedo passa; como folhelho que a tempestade lança da eira, e como a fumaça da chaminé.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἔσονται ὡς νεφέλη πρωινὴ καὶ ὡς δρόσος ὀρθρινὴ πορευομένη ὥσπερ χνοῦς ἀποφυσώμενος ἀφ' ἅλωνος καὶ ὡς ἀτμὶς ἀπὸ ἀκρίδων

text_en: But I am the Lord your God from the land of Egypt : and you shall know no God but me, and there is no saviour beside me.
text_la: Ego autem Dominus Deus tuus, ex terra Ægypti; et Deum absque me nescies, et salvator non est præter me.
text_pt: Todavia, eu sou o Senhor teu Deus desde a terra do Egito; portanto não reconhecerás outro deus além de mim, porque não há Salvador senão eu.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ κύριος ὁ θεός σου στερεῶν οὐρανὸν καὶ κτίζων γῆν οὗ αἱ χεῖρες ἔκτισαν πᾶσαν τὴν στρατιὰν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ οὐ παρέδειξά σοι αὐτὰ τοῦ πορεύεσθαι ὀπίσω αὐτῶν καὶ ἐγὼ ἀνήγαγόν σε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου καὶ θεὸν πλὴν ἐμοῦ οὐ γνώσῃ καὶ σῴζων οὐκ ἔστιν πάρεξ ἐμοῦ

text_en: I knew you in the desert , in the land of the wilderness .
text_la: Ego cognovi te in deserto, in terra solitudinis.
text_pt: Eu te conheci no deserto, na terra muito seca.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἐποίμαινόν σε ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐν γῇ ἀοικήτῳ

text_en: According to their pastures they were filled, and were made full: and they lifted up their heart, and have forgotten me.
text_la: Juxta pascua sua adimpleti sunt et saturati sunt; et levaverunt cor suum, et obliti sunt mei.
text_pt: Depois eles se fartaram em proporção do seu pasto; estando fartos, ensoberbeceu-se o seu coração, por isso se esqueceram de mim.
text_el: κατὰ τὰς νομὰς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐνεπλήσθησαν εἰς πλησμονήν καὶ ὑψώθησαν αἱ καρδίαι αὐτῶν ἕνεκα τούτου ἐπελάθοντό μου

text_en: And I will be to them as a lioness, as a leopard in the way of the Assyrians .
text_la: Et ego ero eis quasi leæna, sicut pardus in via Assyriorum.
text_pt: Serei, pois, para eles como leão; como leopardo espiarei no caminho.
text_el: καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς ὡς πανθὴρ καὶ ὡς πάρδαλις κατὰ τὴν ὁδὸν Ἀσσυρίων

text_en: I will meet them as a bear that is robbed of her whelps, and I will rend the inner parts of their liver: and I will devour them there as a lion, the beast of the field shall tear them.
text_la: Occurram eis quasi ursa raptis catulis, et dirumpam interiora jecoris eorum, et consumam eos ibi quasi leo : bestia agri scindet eos.
text_pt: Como ursa roubada dos seus filhos, os encontrarei, e lhes romperei as teias do seu coração, e como leão ali os devorarei; as feras do campo os despedaçarão.
text_el: ἀπαντήσομαι αὐτοῖς ὡς ἄρκος ἀπορουμένη καὶ διαρρήξω συγκλεισμὸν καρδίας αὐτῶν καὶ καταφάγονται αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ σκύμνοι δρυμοῦ θηρία ἀγροῦ διασπάσει αὐτούς

text_en: Destruction is your own, O Israel : your help is only in me.
text_la: Perditio tua, Israël : tantummodo in me auxilium tuum.
text_pt: Para a tua perda, ó Israel, te rebelaste contra mim, a saber, contra o teu ajudador.
text_el: τῇ διαφθορᾷ σου Ισραηλ τίς βοηθήσει

text_en: Where is your king? now especially let him save you in all your cities: and your judges, of whom you said: Give me kings and princes.
text_la: Ubi est rex tuus? maxime nunc salvet te in omnibus urbibus tuis; et judices tui, de quibus dixisti : Da mihi regem et principes.
text_pt: Onde está agora o teu rei, para que te guarde em todas as tuas cidades, e os teus juízes, dos quais disseste: Dá-me rei e príncipes?
text_el: ποῦ ὁ βασιλεύς σου οὗτος καὶ διασωσάτω σε ἐν πάσαις ταῖς πόλεσίν σου κρινάτω σε ὃν εἶπας δός μοι βασιλέα καὶ ἄρχοντα

text_en: I will give you a king in my wrath , and will take him away in my indignation.
text_la: Dabo tibi regem in furore meo, et auferam in indignatione mea.
text_pt: Dei-te um rei na minha ira, e tirei-o no meu furor.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκά σοι βασιλέα ἐν ὀργῇ μου καὶ ἔσχον ἐν τῷ θυμῷ μου

text_en: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up, his sin is hidden.
text_la: Colligata est iniquitas Ephraim; absconditum peccatum ejus.
text_pt: A iniqüidade de Efraim está atada, o seu pecado está armazenado.
text_el: συστροφὴν ἀδικίας Εφραιμ ἐγκεκρυμμένη ἡ ἁμαρτία αὐτοῦ

text_en: The sorrows of a woman in labour shall come upon him, he is an unwise son: for now he shall not stand in the breach of the children.
text_la: Dolores parturientis venient ei : ipse filius non sapiens : nunc enim non stabit in contritione filiorum.
text_pt: Dores de mulher de parto lhe sobrevirão; ele é um filho insensato; porque é tempo e não está no lugar em que deve vir à luz.
text_el: ὠδῖνες ὡς τικτούσης ἥξουσιν αὐτῷ οὗτος ὁ υἱός σου οὐ φρόνιμος διότι οὐ μὴ ὑποστῇ ἐν συντριβῇ τέκνων

text_en: I will deliver them out of the hand of death. I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be your death; O hell, I will be your bite: comfort is hidden from my eyes.
text_la: De manu mortis liberabo eos; de morte redimam eos. Ero mors tua, o mors! morsus tuus ero, inferne! consolatio abscondita est ab oculis meis.
text_pt: Eu os remirei da mão do inferno, e os resgatarei da morte. Onde estão, ó morte, as tuas pragas? Onde está, ó inferno, a tua perdição? O arrependimento está escondido de meus olhos.
text_el: ἐκ χειρὸς ᾅδου ῥύσομαι αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐκ θανάτου λυτρώσομαι αὐτούς ποῦ ἡ δίκη σου θάνατε ποῦ τὸ κέντρον σου ᾅδη παράκλησις κέκρυπται ἀπὸ ὀφθαλμῶν μου

text_en: Because he shall make a separation between brothers: the Lord will bring a burning wind that shall rise from the desert , and it shall dry up his springs, and shall make his fountain desolate, and he shall carry off the treasure of every desirable vessel.
text_la: Quia ipse inter fratres dividet : adducet urentem ventum Dominus de deserto ascendentem, et siccabit venas ejus, et desolabit fontem ejus : et ipse diripiet thesaurum omnis vasis desiderabilis.
text_pt: Ainda que ele dê fruto entre os irmãos, virá o vento leste, vento do Senhor, subindo do deserto, e secar-se-á a sua nascente, e secar-se-á a sua fonte; ele saqueará o tesouro de todos os vasos desejáveis.
text_el: διότι οὗτος ἀνὰ μέσον ἀδελφῶν διαστελεῖ ἐπάξει ἄνεμον καύσωνα κύριος ἐκ τῆς ἐρήμου ἐπ' αὐτόν καὶ ἀναξηρανεῖ τὰς φλέβας αὐτοῦ ἐξερημώσει τὰς πηγὰς αὐτοῦ αὐτὸς καταξηρανεῖ τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη τὰ ἐπιθυμητὰ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Let Samaria perish, because she has stirred up her God to bitterness: let them perish by the sword, let their little ones be dashed, and let the women with child be ripped up.
text_la: Pereat Samaria, quoniam ad amaritudinem concitavit Deum suum! in gladio pereant, parvuli eorum elidantur, et fœtæ ejus discindantur!
text_pt: Converte-te, ó Israel, ao SENHOR teu Deus; porque pelos teus pecados tens caído.
text_el: ἀφανισθήσεται Σαμάρεια ὅτι ἀντέστη πρὸς τὸν θεὸν αὐτῆς ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ πεσοῦνται αὐτοί καὶ τὰ ὑποτίτθια αὐτῶν ἐδαφισθήσονται καὶ αἱ ἐν γαστρὶ ἔχουσαι αὐτῶν διαρραγήσονται

text_en: Return, O Israel , to the Lord your God : for you have fallen down by your iniquity .
text_la: Convertere, Israël, ad Dominum Deum tuum, quoniam corruisti in iniquitate tua.
text_pt: Tomai convosco palavras, e convertei-vos ao Senhor; dizei-lhe: Tira toda a iniqüidade, e aceita o que é bom; e ofereceremos como novilhos os sacrifícios dos nossos lábios.
text_el: ἐπιστράφητι Ισραηλ πρὸς κύριον τὸν θεόν σου διότι ἠσθένησας ἐν ταῖς ἀδικίαις σου

text_en: Take with you words, and return to the Lord , and say to him: Take away all iniquity , and receive the good : and we will render the calves of our lips.
text_la: Tollite vobiscum verba, et convertimini ad Dominum; et dicite ei : Omnem aufer iniquitatem, accipe bonum, et reddemus vitulos labiorum nostrorum.
text_pt: Não nos salvará a Assíria, não iremos montados em cavalos, e à obra das nossas mãos já não diremos mais: Tu és o nosso deus; porque por ti o órfão alcança misericórdia.
text_el: λάβετε μεθ' ἑαυτῶν λόγους καὶ ἐπιστράφητε πρὸς κύριον τὸν θεὸν ὑμῶν εἴπατε αὐτῷ ὅπως μὴ λάβητε ἀδικίαν καὶ λάβητε ἀγαθά καὶ ἀνταποδώσομεν καρπὸν χειλέων ἡμῶν

text_en: Assyria shall not save us, we will not ride upon horses, neither will we say any more: The works of our hands are our gods : for you will have mercy on the fatherless that is in you.
text_la: Assur non salvabit nos : super equum non ascendemus, nec dicemus ultra, Dii nostri opera manuum nostrarum : quia ejus, qui in te est, misereberis pupilli.
text_pt: Eu sararei a sua infidelidade, eu voluntariamente os amarei; porque a minha ira se apartou deles.
text_el: Ασσουρ οὐ μὴ σώσῃ ἡμᾶς ἐφ' ἵππον οὐκ ἀναβησόμεθα οὐκέτι μὴ εἴπωμεν θεοὶ ἡμῶν τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν χειρῶν ἡμῶν ὁ ἐν σοὶ ἐλεήσει ὀρφανόν

text_en: I will heal their breaches, I will love them freely: for my wrath is turned away from them.
text_la: Sanabo contritiones eorum; diligam eos spontanee : quia aversus est furor meus ab eis.
text_pt: Eu serei para Israel como o orvalho. Ele florescerá como o lírio e lançará as suas raízes como o Líbano.
text_el: ἰάσομαι τὰς κατοικίας αὐτῶν ἀγαπήσω αὐτοὺς ὁμολόγως ὅτι ἀπέστρεψεν ἡ ὀργή μου ἀπ' αὐτῶν

text_en: I will be as the dew, Israel shall spring as the lily, and his root shall shoot forth as that of Libanus .
text_la: Ero quasi ros; Israël germinabit sicut lilium, et erumpet radix ejus ut Libani.
text_pt: Estender-se-ão os seus galhos, e a sua glória será como a da oliveira, e sua fragrância como a do Líbano.
text_el: ἔσομαι ὡς δρόσος τῷ Ισραηλ ἀνθήσει ὡς κρίνον καὶ βαλεῖ τὰς ῥίζας αὐτοῦ ὡς ὁ Λίβανος

text_en: His branches shall spread, and his glory shall be as the olive tree: and his smell as that of Libanus .
text_la: Ibunt rami ejus, et erit quasi oliva gloria ejus, et odor ejus ut Libani.
text_pt: Voltarão os que habitam debaixo da sua sombra; serão vivificados como o trigo, e florescerão como a vide; a sua memória será como o vinho do Líbano.
text_el: πορεύσονται οἱ κλάδοι αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσται ὡς ἐλαία κατάκαρπος καὶ ἡ ὀσφρασία αὐτοῦ ὡς Λιβάνου

text_en: They shall be converted that sit under his shadow: they shall live upon wheat, and they shall blossom as a vine: his memorial shall be as the wine of Libanus .
text_la: Convertentur sedentes in umbra ejus; vivent tritico, et germinabunt quasi vinea; memoriale ejus sicut vinum Libani.
text_pt: Efraim dirá: Que mais tenho eu com os ídolos? Eu o tenho ouvido, e cuidarei dele; eu sou como a faia verde; de mim é achado o teu fruto.
text_el: ἐπιστρέψουσιν καὶ καθιοῦνται ὑπὸ τὴν σκέπην αὐτοῦ ζήσονται καὶ μεθυσθήσονται σίτῳ καὶ ἐξανθήσει ὡς ἄμπελος τὸ μνημόσυνον αὐτοῦ ὡς οἶνος Λιβάνου

text_en: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols ? I will hear him, and I will make him flourish like a green fir tree: from me is your fruit found.
text_la: Ephraim, quid mihi ultra idola? Ego exaudiam, et dirigam eum ego ut abietem virentem; ex me fructus tuus inventus est.
text_pt: Quem é sábio, para que entenda estas coisas? Quem é prudente, para que as saiba? Porque os caminhos do Senhor são retos, e os justos andarão neles, mas os transgressores neles cairão.
text_el: τῷ Εφραιμ τί αὐτῷ ἔτι καὶ εἰδώλοις ἐγὼ ἐταπείνωσα αὐτόν καὶ ἐγὼ κατισχύσω αὐτόν ἐγὼ ὡς ἄρκευθος πυκάζουσα ἐξ ἐμοῦ ὁ καρπός σου εὕρηται

text_en: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent , and he shall know these things? For the ways of the Lord are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall in them.
text_la: Quis sapiens, et intelliget ista? intelligens, et sciet hæc? quia rectæ viæ Domini, et justi ambulabunt in eis; prævaricatores vero corruent in eis.
text_el: τίς σοφὸς καὶ συνήσει ταῦτα ἢ συνετὸς καὶ ἐπιγνώσεται αὐτά διότι εὐθεῖαι αἱ ὁδοὶ τοῦ κυρίου καὶ δίκαιοι πορεύσονται ἐν αὐταῖς οἱ δὲ ἀσεβεῖς ἀσθενήσουσιν ἐν αὐταῖς
